title: Hand back the field of view first and the follow only if it is still the borrower's, with explicit StandDown, Yield, Hold, GiveBack and Take decisions
description: KSAGolf keeps the borrowing rules in a KSA-free Sim layer with a thin KsaWorld adapter, always returns the field of view and restores the follow only when it is unchanged; the ViewClaim decision table is headless-tested

title: Record the main view before the first write when flying another craft or a first-person kitten
description: KSAStructures records mode, follow target and field of view with RememberMainView before borrowing the view for the office computer and the first-person kitten and hands them back with TryHandBackMainView from Leave

title: Capture the baseline pose, follow, mode and tidal locking, blend back on release and detect a second writer
description: gatOS' director captures everything it will change at Take, restores it after a release blend, and stands down rather than fight when the controller faulted, another mod replaced it, or the mode or follow changed

title: Rank several camera users with a pure ViewClaim ladder and drive the claimants in claim order
description: KSArmory's chase, sight, camera windows, watch camera and developer bridge share the main view through a headless-tested ViewClaim ladder where a loser yields without restoring and the bridge's held pose is just another claimant

title: Borrow the main camera, hand it back and arbitrate between camera users
description: How a mod takes the player's main view, records what it changes, returns each half only if the player did not change it meanwhile, and shares the view with other features or mods

title: Chase a round with a RoundFollowable on a level-horizon controller, the pose solved in the viewport pass
description: KSArmory follows the round itself through RoundFollowable, installs a FixedController subclass for a stable up vector and orbit drag, and solves the stand-off pose from settled state inside the engine's viewport pass

title: Hold a line to the target near the flight path with a carried lift and lean off the singular axis
description: KSAGolf's pure ChaseView solves a stable eye behind a fast ball, held within 80 degrees of the flight path with a carried lift and a lean off the axis the stock controller cannot cross; only the geometry is tested and part of it is wired in game at the pinned ref
hooks: subclass KSA.FixedController.OnFrame (intended; ChaseView has no in-game caller at the pinned ref)

title: Chase a projectile or other fast body with the main camera
description: A mod-simulated shell, ball or missile is not a Vehicle, so the camera follows it through a custom IFollowable and a level, stable pose behind the flight path

title: Follow a point with an anchor IFollowable that re-resolves a vessel, part, body or held point on every call
description: gatOS implements IFollowable as CameraFollowable, whose GetPositionEcl re-resolves its anchor each call, with identity body-fixed rotation, a one metre radius and a stable OrbitView, so the stock camera tracks a point with no registration

title: Report the drawn position of a mod-simulated round from a RoundFollowable
description: KSArmory's RoundFollowable answers the position a round is drawn at this frame, with a non-zero radius, a stable OrbitView and an identity body-fixed rotation, so the camera and the picture agree and the stock controllers do not hit a null OrbitView

title: Change the follow target with changeControl and alert false, then write the captured position back
description: gatOS' director follows its own anchor with SetFollow(changeControl false, alert false) and restores the captured position and rotation because SetFollow teleports the camera, and uses the same pair to change tidal locking

title: Follow on the main viewport without taking control, with follow and mode kept as separate halves
description: KSArmory's TryFollowOnMainViewport points the main camera at a mod object with SetFollow(changeControl false), because following a non-Vehicle with the default would null the player's controlled vehicle

title: Re-apply the follow after every viewport claim on a secondary camera
description: Hot Pursuit repeats SetFollow with changeControl and alert false after each secondary viewport claim, because a claim resets the viewport to defaults, and unfollows when its target is gone

title: Make the camera follow a point or mod-simulated object, and change the follow target without a jump
description: Camera.Following takes any IFollowable, so a mod object can be followed with no registration; what the interface must answer, and how SetFollow's teleport and control swap are avoided

title: Hold a lens field of view with prefixes on Camera.UpdateProjection and ChangeFieldOfView, main camera only
description: Glass writes the private _fovRadians in a prefix on UpdateProjection and swallows the stock zoom keys in a prefix on ChangeFieldOfView, both gated on ViewportRegistry.IsMainCamera, with lens presets driven from a static FovController and saved with the scene

title: Call SetFieldOfView in degrees, read GetFieldOfView in radians and zoom past the player clamp
description: KSArmory clamps its own writes to 1 to 120 degrees because the projection throws outside 0 to 180, restates the field every frame because the zoom keys clamp at 15, and resets released camera windows to 50 degrees

title: Treat the field of view as one half of a borrowed view and always return it first
description: KSAGolf records the main view's field of view with the mode and follow, clamps its own writes to 1 to 120 degrees and restores the field before the mode because SetFieldOfView does not clamp and the player's zoom keys cannot widen a narrow value

title: Override the camera field of view and zoom past the stock clamp
description: Camera.SetFieldOfView takes degrees without clamping, GetFieldOfView answers radians, the zoom keys clamp to 15 to 120 degrees and the projection throws outside 0 to 180, and three ways mods hold a field

title: Aim from the GUI hook with LookAt, then rebuild the matrices and per-viewport shader data and fill the nearby body yourself
description: KSArmory unfollows and sets Fixed, anchors the eye on the platform as that window's camera draws it, writes the pose with LookAt, then calls Camera.OnFrame, UpdateShaderData and SetCameraUbo and copies the nearby-celestial state the engine only computes for the frame camera

title: Write the pose in a FixedController.OnFrame prefix before Camera.OnFrame and synchronize the nearby body inside it
description: Hot Pursuit composes the pose in the main camera's ego space, writes it before the stock Camera.OnFrame builds the matrices, repeats ClampCamera and fills the camera's nearby-celestial fields in the same prefix so no matrix rebuild is needed

title: Aim a secondary viewport camera, rebuild its matrices and give it its nearby body
description: A secondary camera follows nothing and has its matrices built before a GUI hook runs, and the engine fills its nearby planet only for the frame camera; two ways to aim it correctly

title: Open a secondary viewport, make it visible and re-resolve its index by reference every frame
description: KSArmory and KSAStructures lease a spare camera window with ViewportRegistry.TryOpenSecondaryViewport, find it again by reference in GameViews each frame, disable the control when AvailableSecondaryCount is zero and hand it back with ReleaseSecondaryViewport

title: Claim a viewport per camera with an IViewportOwner, track the lease every update and keep KSA's window
description: Hot Pursuit gives each camera its own owner token for TryClaimSecondaryViewport, re-applies name, size, field of view, follow and visibility after every claim, polls TryGetOwned and shows the picture in KSA's resizable window

title: Clear HasUi and RenderOrbitLines through the reflected OptionFlags setter and draw the viewport texture in your own window
description: KSArmory takes KSA's window off a leased viewport by clearing its HasUi and RenderOrbitLines flags with the protected OptionFlags setter, then draws ViewportBase.ImGuiTexture in an ImGui window of its own with controls over the picture

title: Lease a secondary viewport for a mod camera and show it in a window
description: KSA seals its viewport registry at boot and offers four spare secondary camera windows; how mods claim, configure, track and release one and show its picture in KSA's window or their own

title: Pose a camera from the part's Asmb2Ego matrices in a FixedController.OnFrame prefix
description: Hot Pursuit composes the vehicle matrix in the main camera's ego space with the sub-part chain, transforms the mount normal by the inverse-transpose so scaled parts do not skew the aim, and writes the pose before Camera.OnFrame builds the matrices

title: Resolve the eye, sight line and roll from an optical head sub-part for the main view or a camera window
description: KSArmory's optical head reads its base subpart's transform from the engine, pivots a head subpart by a rate-limited drive and answers the eye and line of sight against a platform position the caller supplies so the sight and the camera windows are posed inside the viewport pass

title: Click a hull point and store it in the hit sub-part's local frame
description: Hot Pursuit raycasts the cursor against every vessel's part meshes with Part.RayCastEgo, stores the hit point and normal in the closest sub-part's local frame with the vehicle id and Part.InstanceId, and re-resolves them every frame so a camera pauses instead of failing when its target is gone

title: Mount a camera on a vessel part and look through it
description: Posing a secondary or main camera from a sub-part's transform so it rides a nose, mast or turret, including scaled and articulated parts and mounts that survive staging

title: Queue animations into a KeyframeSequencePlayer with groups and return-to-start, and save the recipes with the scene
description: Camera Controller Override plays a list of keyframes through one prefix on the Orbit and Free controllers, runs simultaneous moves as an AnimationGroup, blends back to the start pose and stores the authored sequence as validated recipe JSON restored stopped on load

title: Write eased single moves as IKeyframeAnimation classes driven from the OnFrame prefix
description: Ten built-in moves share an interface, an easing helper and target-relative geometry; each captures its start state at Initialize and writes the live camera in Update, using absolute angles from the captured start to avoid drift

title: Animate the flight camera with eased moves, keyframe sequences and saved recipes
description: Small animation classes that edit the live Orbit or Free camera each frame, queued into a sequence that plays, pauses, groups moves, blends back to the start and is stored as validated recipe JSON

title: Read the head bone through an IAnimProcessor, pose the eye in the viewport pass and walk where the kitten looks
description: KSAStructures adds an EyesPose animation processor to the flown kitten's avatar, converts the Head_M bone to the ecliptic, borrows the main view in Fixed mode, takes right-drag look through the controller and patches KittenLocomotion.StepGrounded to face and walk along the look

title: Pose the eye from the head bone in the golf pose with a pitch-tilted up, a captured-cursor look and a drawn turn for a standing kitten
description: KSAGolf builds the first-person eye 12 cm ahead of and 5 cm above the head bone, tilts the up vector with pitch, looks with the captured cursor at 0.08 degrees per pixel or a right-drag at the orbit rate, and draws the turn to the look on the skeleton until the kitten walks

title: Put the camera in an EVA kitten's eyes, with mouse look and look-driven walking
description: How a mod reads the head bone, borrows the main view in Fixed mode at that point, keeps a mouse look in a world frame and makes the walking kitten face where the player looks

title: Play scripted cinematic camera tracks with blends and easing
description: KSA has no camera track system, so mods compose keyframed shots over the player's camera in game-free code and apply them from the viewport pass, blending in and out

title: Compose each frame's pose from keyframed tracks, manual overrides and a captured baseline
description: gatOS evaluates Track over Override over Baseline per channel in a game-free compositor, with spline and easing playback, and applies the composed pose from a FixedController subclass inside the viewport pass

title: Smoothstep the eye, lerp the look at equal depth and pace the ease with an averaged step
description: KSAGolf's ChaseView.TryBlend smoothsteps the eye from the player's pose onto the chase and lerps the look at one depth, and SmoothedStep evens the simulated step for cosmetic eases that survive uneven frame times and pauses; both are headless-tested only at the pinned ref

title: Blend back to the start pose when a sequence ends
description: Camera Controller Override interpolates the offset and slerps the rotation from the final keyframe back to the captured start pose, re-adding the followed object's position each frame so the blend tracks a moving vessel

title: Release with a blend and shape tracks with named easing functions
description: gatOS hands the camera back over camera_release_blend_s with an in-out ease that lerps position, slerps rotation and lerps the field of view to the captured baseline, and shapes tracks with linear, in, out, in-out and Bezier easings

title: Let the IVA camera leave the seat and fly around the cabin
description: How IVA mode is pinned to a seat, what depends on the mode staying IVA, and the controller-swap approach that frees the camera without losing interiors, audio or ray tracing

title: Let the IVA camera leave the seat with an IVAController subclass that delegates movement to a private FlyController
description: Kitchen Sink swaps the main viewport's IvaController for a subclass that stays in IVA mode but flies like the free camera in the vessel's body frame, with a Return to Seat path, a head-visibility postfix and scene-save restore

title: Build the ring reference tree, assign it to BodyTemplate.RingsReference, dispose and recreate the rings renderer
description: Give any moon or planet a ring by constructing the same reference classes the XML loader would, validating every asset first, assigning the tree to the body template and forcing the rings renderer to be recreated, with painted band textures

title: Mutate the public ring reference tree, snapshot originals and recreate the rings renderer
description: Swap the LOD meshes, rock material, band texture and field settings of an existing ring by writing into the public reference tree, cloning interleaved atlas meshes into simple ring-usable meshes, and forcing the rings renderer to rebuild

title: Add planetary rings to a body or restyle existing rings at runtime
description: Build a PlanetaryRingsReference tree in code and assign it to a body template, or mutate an existing ring's meshes, textures and field settings, then dispose and recreate the rings renderer so the game rebuilds its baked ring data

title: Snapshot, mutate the public tree and recreate one renderer by reflection
description: Change a body's loaded reference data, then dispose a single renderer and clear its created flag so the game's own rebuild constructs it again from the new data, with a snapshot for exact restore

title: Transactional apply and exact restore of a body's clutter data
description: Swap a body's clutter objects in one main-thread step at the solver handoff, retain the originals for exact restore, and hook GroundClutterRenderer rebuild and dispose so a renderer recreation rebuilds or releases the override

title: Assign to the template and call Program.RebuildRenderer
description: Add or remove data on a body template, dispose the one renderer that caches it, refresh its body list and ask the whole renderer to rebuild, accepting a short hitch

title: Reflect the mapped buffer and slot, clamp when the camera is near, restore on leaving
description: Change one biome material value in the planet renderer's persistently mapped storage buffer without a rebuild, only when the camera crosses a threshold, saving the original and restoring it afterwards

title: Change loaded game data at runtime and make the renderer rebuild from it
description: Many KSA renderers bake XML-backed reference data into GPU buffers in their constructors, so editing the reference object does nothing until the renderer is recreated; four patterns for mutate-and-recreate, transactional swap, template assignment and in-place buffer writes

title: Transpile the distance comparison into a ranking call that favours a body within 25 radii
description: Rewrite the surface-versus-centre comparison in CelestialSystem.GetNearbyAstronomical with a transpiler that shape-checks the IL, calls a static ranking method that favours a body the camera is within 25 radii of, and returns the original IL on any mismatch

title: Control which body the game picks as the camera's nearby celestial
description: The game draws one body per camera in full detail and every other as a distant sphere, chosen by CelestialSystem.GetNearbyAstronomical; a small moon can steal the slot and make its planet flicker, fixed here by a guarded transpiler

title: Promote a body to AtmosphericBody and splice generated Atmosphere values into the XML
description: Rename a PlanetaryBody or MinorBody element to AtmosphericBody, insert a complete Atmosphere block, and tune Rayleigh, Mie and ozone terms per body with generated values and data-as-key conventions

title: Templated decks and laminae with absolute asset paths
description: Add a Clouds block with one templated deck per giant planet and thin laminae for haze, pointing textures at absolute paths in a mod folder and deriving light distance and flow speed from layer geometry and measured winds

title: Python asset scripts with encodings matched to the shader that reads them
description: Build cloud coverage, detail and flowmap textures offline with scripts whose channel layouts follow the stock cloud shader, check the scripts in and keep large derived textures out of the repository

title: Define atmospheres, scattering and cloud layers for a body in system XML
description: Promote a body to AtmosphericBody with a complete Atmosphere block, tune Rayleigh, Mie and ozone terms, add a sibling Clouds block with coverage masks, detail tiles, flowmaps and cloud types, and build the textures offline

title: Python generator emitting checked-in C# tables for flight and shaders
description: Integrate per-body reference profiles hydrostatically, apply KSA's boundary thresholds, decimate to the nodes that reproduce ln density and ln pressure within tolerance, and emit one generated C# file consumed by the flight patch, the XML and the shader tables

title: Generate measured atmosphere tables from reference profiles
description: Build compact altitude tables offline from probe and reference-atmosphere data, apply KSA's own boundary rule, decimate to the nodes that reproduce ln density within tolerance, and emit one generated source file for flight and shaders

title: Header-indexed CSV parse into HIP-keyed ecliptic directions with synthetic keys
description: Parse a bundled AT-HYG star catalog by header name into Hipparcos-keyed ecliptic unit vectors, names and information records, giving named stars without a Hipparcos number a synthetic key and the Sun a live position

title: Parse .fab and names files and filter to the stars present in the stock binary
description: Load Stellarium legacy constellationship and constellation_names files for many sky cultures, join them to the catalog by Hipparcos number and keep only segments whose both ends match a star direction in the stock star binary

title: Bundle a star catalog and constellation data and join them to the game's sky
description: Ship a reduced AT-HYG CSV keyed by Hipparcos number, convert equatorial J2000 to the game's ecliptic directions, and optionally load Stellarium constellation files filtered to the stars present in the stock star binary

title: Latch on the Universe.CurrentSystem reference, not its Id
description: Rebuild a per-system graph and every cache derived from it only when the CelestialSystem object changes, because reloading the same id creates new body objects

title: ConditionalWeakTable of immutable statics per Celestial
description: Cache each body's constant data in a ConditionalWeakTable keyed by the body instance so a system reload invalidates it automatically, and read only position and velocity per sample

title: One-shot attach on the first UI frame with a universe
description: Match data loaded before any celestial exists to live bodies on the first UI frame where the universe is ready, compute derived numbers once and read only the live values per frame

title: Dotted path of Celestial ids from the top-level body down
description: Key mod data about bodies by a dotted path of Celestial ids such as Jupiter.Io, build it by walking Parent, and resolve the key back to the live object by matching the last segment and its parent depth-first under a root

title: Prefix-keyed JSON files discovered in every installed mod folder
description: Let any installed mod add or override per-body data by dropping a JSON file with a marker key and system-prefixed body keys beside it, with deterministic precedence and a lookup key order that survives repeated ids

title: Cache and key per-body data so it survives system reloads, repeated ids and extra star systems
description: Derived body data is constant for a loaded system but a cache must die when the system is reloaded or a body object is replaced; five invalidation and key designs from reference latches to prefix-keyed JSON catalogs

title: Native system XML with library references and an optional local body
description: Create a native system preset that loads Sol and one stock planet, selects a home body, and optionally includes a separately registered local body

title: Compose a reduced star system from library bodies
description: Register a native system XML that selects a star and chosen library bodies, assigns their parents and home body, and optionally adds a local body asset

title: Roots then IParentBody.Children into an immutable forest, with role rules in a game-type-free class
description: Build an immutable forest of every star system by walking CelestialSystem.All for independent roots and recursing through IParentBody.Children, keeping only astronomical parents and classifying stars, barycenters and minor-body exoplanets by pure rules

title: Universe.Roots, RootOf and a selected root, collecting only Celestials or only stars
description: Use Universe.Roots and IIndependentRoot.RootOf to offer a system choice, recurse through Children to collect planets and moons or stars and barycenters, and keep your own selected root because WorldSun moves

title: Flat scan of CurrentSystem.All plus an explicit WorldSun
description: Enumerate every body with one scan of CelestialSystem.All, reading Parent per body instead of walking children, and add the root star explicitly because it is a StellarBody and not a Celestial

title: Enumerate every star system, star, planet and moon of the loaded universe
description: Walk the loaded universe's roots and body tree, a flat CelestialSystem.All scan or a player-selected root, and avoid the type traps that stars are not Celestials and Children also lists vehicles

title: SetOrbit plus manual Children surgery and UpdatePerFrameDataTree, with cycle guards on replay
description: Swap a celestial's orbit and, when the parent differs, move it between the old and new parents' Children lists, then refresh the moved subtree so nothing samples stale frames

title: Priority.First prefix on ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers builds a fresh orbit from the target's state vectors
description: Make a planet or moon follow another body at an offset by building a new orbit from the target's freshly applied state vectors in a first-priority prefix at the solver handoff, ordering chained updates and restoring the original orbit on unweld

title: Move a planet or moon at runtime by swapping its orbit or changing its parent
description: Bodies are on rails, so moving one means giving it a new Orbit at a moment the orbit solver will pick it up, then repairing the Children lists, cached transforms and subtree by hand; and restoring the original orbit afterwards

title: Place starting vessels in a custom system with reusable situations
description: Register orbital Situation assets and reference them from library-loaded starter vessels in a native system XML

title: Situation assets referenced by a library-loaded starter vessel
description: Define a reusable orbital Situation and bind a stock default vehicle to it in a custom system for Testing mode

title: Read KSA's star binary files and reload or replace the star field at runtime
description: The 16-byte star record format named by mod.toml, how to read it for catalog joins, and how to swap the star field at runtime by rewriting Mod.StarBinaries, resetting the instanced star technique and refilling it within its capacity

title: Mirror Mod.LoadStarBinaries when parsing
description: Read a star binary with the same count-then-16-byte-record layout the game uses, keep the float direction bits as identity for joining catalog entries, and cap the read by the file length

title: Reflect Mod.StarBinaries, reset and refill the star technique, confirm through a game Popup
description: Switch the star field at runtime by listing star binaries in every loaded mod, rewriting the private StarBinaries, resetting every viewport's star instances, refilling within capacity by proportional stride sampling and uploading the instance buffer

title: Read a body's atmosphere, ocean, ring, rotation, tilt, tidal-lock and orbit-element data
description: Where each per-body number lives in KSA (IParentBody, the body template, transforms and the orbit), how to read atmosphere and ocean data that may be null, sample density and pressure by altitude, and the corrections moons need for tilt and inclination

title: IParentBody.GetAtmosphereReference and GetOceanReference projected into a snapshot
description: Read mass, radius, spin, atmosphere and ocean data of any body through the IParentBody interface into an immutable snapshot, treating a missing atmosphere or ocean as null and caching constants per body

title: Atmosphere height, density and ring templates feeding classification decisions, and angular velocity to a stationary orbit radius
description: Use a body's atmosphere height and radius to classify gas giants, derive a low-orbit radius, mark ringed bodies and compute the synchronous orbit radius from the angular velocity, all from live data with no per-body config

title: Sample the live density and pressure model by altitude
description: Plot a body's atmospheric density and pressure against altitude by sampling the game's own PhysicalAtmosphereReference functions at 101 points, so the chart follows any mod that replaces the profile

title: Template and transform reads for tilt, periods and inclination
description: Read axial tilt, sidereal period, tidal lock, retrograde flag and orbit inclination from the body template, the orbit and the orbital-plane transform, with the corrections the Compendium mod applies for moons

title: Deserialize DecalModifierReference XML and add it to both modifier lists before the renderer is built
description: Write a Decal modifier as XML in a C# string, deserialize it with the engine's own type, run OnDataLoad with your mod, and add it to a body's ProceduralModifiers and TerrainModifiers at StarMapAllModsLoaded

title: Levelling decal plus additive pit height map, ordered after the stock pad decal
description: Compose an absolute-level decal with an additive height-map decal so a dug site meets the stock launch pad without a step, and route cover meshes to the terrain draw bucket

title: Add terrain decals from code and flatten or dig the ground under a custom site
description: Add DecalModifierReference terrain modifiers to a body at load so the ground is drawn, collided with, queried and cluttered consistently, and compose a levelling decal with a height-map pit that meets the stock launch pad

title: Sphere pick, GetLatitudeFromCce and GetLongitudeFromCce, haversine, chord and bearing
description: Pin two points on a planet from the cursor with a sphere ray test, store them as latitude and longitude, and compute great-circle distance, chord and initial bearing

title: Draw a great-circle arc over a planet without drawing through it: 48 Rodrigues samples with a back-face test
description: Sample a great circle between two surface points with Rodrigues rotation, interpolate the radius, and draw each segment only while it faces the camera so the line breaks at the limb

title: Convert a click on a planet to latitude and longitude, measure between points and draw the great-circle arc
description: Ray-test the cursor against each body's mean sphere, convert the hit to latitude and longitude through the body-fixed frame, measure great-circle distance and bearing, and draw the arc only on the visible hemisphere

title: Harmony postfix on the private PopulateLaunchPadExclusionZones with the celestial injected
description: Refill the four ground-clutter exclusion zones with the launch pads nearest the camera by postfixing the private PopulateLaunchPadExclusionZones, using the engine's own formula

title: Prefix on ExecuteNextClothSolvers builds private clutter bundles with originals kept for exact restore
description: Replace the models of chosen ground-clutter types on one body by queueing a recipe and committing it in a first-priority prefix at the solver handoff, with renderer hooks so a renderer recreation keeps the override coherent

title: Per-grid memory with AND-merge, public-API snapshot and replay, native plus sidecar saves
description: Remember knocked-out and displaced clutter instances per ecotype and grid spacing, replay them into whichever placement is installed, and save stock grids natively and override-only grids in a sidecar

title: Keep grass, rocks and trees off a custom site, and replace or preserve a planet's ground clutter
description: Refill the four launch-pad exclusion zones the engine bakes at load, swap a body's clutter types for imported models at the solver handoff, and carry knocked-out or displaced instances across swaps and saves

title: Gradient from centred east, west, north and south differences
description: Measure local ground slope as the magnitude of a centred gradient on a body-fixed east and north frame, with a ring of spokes kept for roughness and an aim-loop gain derived from the arrival angle

title: Surface normal from four one-metre samples and a cross product
description: Compute a unit surface normal by sampling the height field one metre east, west, north and south of a point, crossing the two chords, flipping outward and falling back to radial
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent beside-vessel button and ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows armed terrain click)

title: Per-frame centre and radius, crossing test, interpolation and near-surface resample
description: Stop a mod-simulated round at the terrain by testing a was and now height each sub-step against a per-frame sphere, interpolating the contact point and re-reading the ground near impact

title: Measure ground slope and surface normal, and detect when a mod-simulated point hits the ground
description: Derive the local gradient or surface normal from neighbouring height samples and test ground contact for bodies the engine does not simulate, with interpolation and epoch corrections

title: Place a static object on a planet surface at a latitude and longitude, and keep it anchored
description: Stand XML static objects on a planet with landmark references, redraw them when the engine culls them, and anchor mod-drawn models in the body-fixed frame so they follow rotation and restore from saves

title: IsLaunchPad landmarks added at StarMapAllModsLoaded and a render-data postfix for culled objects
description: Append LandmarkReference entries to a body template before the engine resolves static objects so a multi-part XML building gets render models and colliders, and redraw it with a postfix when the engine culls it

title: GroundAnchor composed each frame into a camera-relative matrix
description: Anchor a mod-drawn model to a planet with a body-fixed position and normal, rebuild its camera-relative matrix every frame in the render-data hook, and restore it from the scene save

title: Course frame anchored at the kitten and saved as latitude, longitude, heading and floor height
description: Anchor a mod-built structure to the ground at a kitten's feet in the body-fixed frame, level its floor above the highest ground, draw its meshes per viewport and save it as latitude, longitude, heading and height above ground

title: Query the terrain height field and test line of sight across terrain
description: Ask KSA how high the ground is along a direction from a body centre, choose between the Ccf and Cce entry points and between fast and accurate sampling, and build sea clamps, ground-contact tests, hover height and line of sight on that one call

title: Ccf versus Cce entry points, sea clamp, no-claim results and a fixed-budget line-of-sight test
description: Read the engine height field with the right entry point, clamp to the sea, treat unreadable samples as no claim, decide when accurate sampling is worth it and build a sphere-then-band line-of-sight test on top

title: Answer as a body centre and surface radius, pick the body by depth, mask radar by horizon
description: Wrap the height query so a mod-simulated round tests its height every sub-step by subtraction, back-date the body's motion, and mask line of sight with non-accurate samples of the real horizon

title: Cache decorator that reuses a height sample until near the ground or moved
description: Keep trajectory previews affordable by wrapping the ground test in a decorator that re-samples only within 600 m of the cached surface or 250 m from where it last sampled

title: Height of the terrain directly below a craft for hover and touchdown
description: Rotate the craft's inertial position into the body-fixed frame and read Celestial.GetTerrainHeightFromDirCcf for a hover and touchdown height, with a finite check and the Ccf versus Cce choice explained

title: Typed SDK with a Transport interface, plus example autopilot programs
description: Build a client where a single Transport interface hides whether the game is reached through files or HTTP, then write a landing or guidance program that paces by sim time, gates on telemetry freshness and batches related writes

title: Build an external SDK client or autopilot for the game over files and HTTP
description: Wrap a mod's external API in a typed client with one Transport interface over files and HTTP, then fly a vessel from a separate process with sim-time pacing, telemetry freshness gates and atomic batch writes

title: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint inside the game process
description: Host the official MCP C# SDK behind a hand-rolled HTTP adapter in the mod, map tools to the command queue and reads to immutable snapshots, and shape the tool surface for a language-model client

title: Stdlib Python stdio MCP server wrapping the file bridge, with image tools

description: Reading every planet, moon and the star into a body catalog, caching the session-constant data per body so each sample only reads ECL position and velocity

title: Ground-clutter texture override
description: Replace a stock ground-clutter texture at runtime by decoding a user image with the game's own loaders and re-pointing its existing bindless texture slot, with the stock view captured for restore and old images retired only after every frame in flight has finished

title: Compile-gated game seam
description: Split the mod class into a game-free half and a Game/ half compiled only when KSA.dll is present, joined by C# partial methods that vanish when the game assemblies are absent, so CI and every library build and test without private game DLLs

title: Debug cheats for teleport, refuel, warp and impulse
description: A gated /sim/debug namespace that teleports vessels to a CCI state vector, applies impulsive kicks, refills propellant and batteries, sets time warp and switches the controlled vessel, each in the frame phase that keeps it race-free

title: Embedded MQTT broker
description: An MQTTnet broker hosted inside the game process publishes retained telemetry topics and a leaf-per-topic mirror of /sim, gated by connected clients, live subscriptions and byte changes, and turns publishes on a command topic into game-thread commands

title: External API clients and SDK
description: A typed TypeScript SDK that runs over either the /sim filesystem or HTTP, plus Rust, TypeScript and shell example programs that fly, film and decorate KSA from inside or outside the guest, demonstrating the external API surface

title: Particle bursts from the emitter pool
description: Spawn one-shot particle effects anchored to a vessel or an EVA kitten's face by taking an emitter from KSA's shared pool and initializing it with a ParticleEmitterReference built entirely in C#, plus the engine facts from the repo's particle-system analysis

title: FMOD audio playback
description: Play user-uploaded audio clips through KSA's own FMOD system and channel groups by creating in-memory sounds, tracking channels on the main thread, and releasing sounds only after no channel uses them, without ever touching the game's System lifecycle

title: Frame hooks with an F2-proof fallback
description: Three StarMap hooks plus a main-viewport Harmony prefix give gatOS one game-thread work slot per frame that keeps running when the player hides the HUD

title: FX editors via reflection
description: Expose the game's built-in engine-plume, plume-trail, cloud and terrain debug editors as live-editable data by reflecting into private renderer fields, replaying each editor's own apply sequence, and recording pristine values so every change can be reset

title: Game-thread command queue
description: Every external write (file, HTTP, MQTT, MCP, serial) becomes an immutable command that a transport thread enqueues and awaits while the game thread drains, routes and executes it with errno-style results

title: HTTP /v1 API server
description: A dependency-free HTTP/1.1 server on a raw TcpListener inside the game process that serves JSON snapshots, Server-Sent Events, a long-poll sim-time wait, an OpenAPI document, a per-leaf mirror of /sim and one generic command endpoint

title: Ignition, staging and module actuators
description: Ignite, shut down, stage, toggle engines and RCS, fire decouplers, undock and drive part animations by calling the same entry points as KSA's own keybinds, most of which queue into the game's input buffers

title: IVA cabin physics in an own Bepu world
description: Make loose cabin props float, slam aft under thrust and fling under rotation by simulating them in a separate BepuPhysics Simulation in the vessel's assembly frame, driven by the vessel's accelerometer and body rates and written back onto IVA SubPart transforms

title: KSA anchor churn tracking
description: Every method that touches a KSA member carries a documentary KsaAnchor attribute with the member, source file, verification date, game version and churn risk, backed by runtime health latches and a scope catalog plus an upgrade playbook that turn a new game build into a bounded work list

title: Part light cone control
description: Switch part lights and change their brightness, colour and spotlight inner and outer cone angles at runtime by cloning each light's shared template per instance, with the engine facts from the repo's analysis of how KSA renders spotlights

title: Logging shim and perf stats
description: A game-free logging interface that every library uses, swapped at load for a sink on KSA's Brutal LogCategory, plus allocation-free single-writer timing and allocation counters shown live in the mod's status window

title: Manual throttle and RCS inputs
description: Setting manual throttle and RCS translate/rotate commands by reflecting into the private Vehicle._manualControlInputs struct, the same field KSA's keyboard handlers write and the solver copies each step

title: MCP server for AI agents
description: A stateless Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol endpoint inside the game process, built on the official C# SDK with a hand-rolled HTTP adapter, that groups the simulation into logical JSON resources and control tools for AI agents

title: ModMenu entry with a fallback menu
description: Draw the same mod menu through ModMenu's ModMenuEntry attribute when ModMenu is installed and through a Harmony postfix on KSA's empty Program.DrawProgramMenusHook when it is not, plus a status window and a confirmation modal that never block on background work

title: 9P2000.L server in C#
description: A from-scratch 9P2000.L codec, TCP server and pluggable virtual filesystem running inside the game process, which the Linux guest mounts as /sim for telemetry and as /mnt for opt-in host folders

title: Part and module state reads
description: Reading engines, tanks, solid motors, batteries, power, RCS, solar panels, docking ports, decouplers, animations and the part tree through KSA's vehicle-wide module lists and struct-of-arrays state lists

title: Programmable camera director
description: Take ownership of KSA's main camera by installing a FixedController subclass through a reflected protected setter, parking the viewport in Fixed mode, and composing each frame's pose from tracks, overrides and a captured baseline inside the engine's own viewport pass

title: purrTTY custom shell contract
description: gatOS plugs a new shell type into another mod's terminal by importing that mod's exported contract assembly through an optional StarMap mod dependency, sharing one registry instance, while still loading cleanly when the other mod is absent

title: qcow2 overlay guest disks
description: Keep a pristine shipped base image read-only and store all guest changes in a per-profile qcow2 overlay in the user data folder, with version-pinned boots, grow-only resize, a PID lock file and a one-click reset

title: QEMU microVM as a game child process
description: Boot, supervise and shut down a QEMU Linux VM from inside a KSA mod with an async state machine, per-OS accelerator ladders with TCG fallback, an SSH readiness probe and a QGA-QMP-kill shutdown ladder, all off the main thread

title: Per-vessel scale and force-render cheats
description: Rescale a whole vessel by writing Part.Scale recursively, keep a vessel drawn at any distance by prefix-replacing KSA's sub-pixel cull, and show IVA interiors from outside by flipping the internal-template flag, each with Harmony patches installed only while in use

title: Screen stream frame capture
description: Capture the game's rendered scene without stalling by transpiling a hook into Program.RenderGame just before its command buffer ends, blitting the offscreen image into a small per-frame-slot staging buffer read back frames later, and streaming it as Kitty terminal graphics

title: Serial bus with CCSDS, NMEA and SCPI
description: A virtual serial port into the guest, backed by a QEMU virtio-serial chardev socket, streams active-vessel telemetry as NDJSON, NMEA-0183 sentences or CCSDS space packets and accepts SCPI-style command lines that answer OK or ERR with an errno

title: The /sim file models
description: How a synthetic 9p filesystem must behave so ordinary Unix tools work on live game data, covering snapshot-memoized sensor files, growing-log streams, blocking event and alarm files, and writable control files that return real errno values

title: Host-guest transport over slirp TCP
description: Every channel between the game process and the guest is plain TCP over QEMU user-mode networking, with host ports advertised on the kernel command line, because virtio-9p, virtiofs and vsock have no host backend on Windows QEMU

title: Snapshot-diff flight events
description: KSA has no public event bus for flight events, so gatOS derives situation, SOI, engine, flameout, docking, decoupling, animation and battery events by diffing consecutive immutable snapshots

title: Solver-phase drain for flight computer setpoints
description: A Priority.First Harmony prefix on Universe.ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers is the one window where flight computer modes, burns, refills and teleports written from the main thread survive KSA's async vehicle solver

title: SSH shell sessions into the guest
description: Each purrTTY terminal tab is an SSH.NET PTY channel into the guest over a loopback port forward, with lazy VM boot on first open, host-key pinning, a non-blocking input writer thread and thread-agnostic output events

title: Projected sticker decals
description: Spray user images onto vessels, terrain and ground clutter as screen-space projected decals drawn after KSA resolves its offscreen target, reconstructing scene positions from the reverse-Z depth buffer in shaders compiled at runtime against the game's own GLSL includes

title: Synthetic camera follow anchor
description: Implement KSA's IFollowable on a mod-owned object that re-resolves a vessel, part, body or fixed point on every call, so the stock camera follows it and every camera pose stays an offset measured in the engine's own frame pass

title: Telemetry sampler and snapshot store
description: A rate-limited game-thread sampler reads every vehicle and body into one immutable snapshot and publishes it with a single volatile swap that any number of transport threads read without locks

title: World-space textured quad (thug_life)
description: Draw a custom textured quad attached to a vessel part into KSA's offscreen scene pass by postfixing SuperMeshRenderSystem.RenderMainPass with a lazily created Vulkan pipeline built against the engine's own render target

title: Timed command scheduler
description: A game-free scheduler that plays back scripts of millisecond-offset commands on render, wall or sim-time clocks, ticked on the game thread immediately before the command drain so a command due this frame executes this frame

title: TOML config seeded from a shipped template
description: Ship an editable gatos.default.toml in the mod folder, copy it once to a live gatos.toml in the user data folder, deserialize with Tomlyn into one typed class, clamp bad values with a warning instead of failing, and persist in-game changes atomically on a background task

title: Vehicle and EVA paint
description: Recolour vessel parts by injecting GLSL into KSA's part fragment shader at compile time and packing colours into spare per-instance state bits, and recolour EVA kittens by binding gatOS-owned material clones, both opt-in and fully reversible

title: Vessel flight-state reads
description: How gatOS reads position, velocity, attitude, altitude, mass, orbit, navball, environment and encounters from KSA.Vehicle each sample, in which coordinate frames, and how it scrubs KSA's sentinels

title: Welds that pin one vessel to another
description: Rigidly attach a source vessel to a target vessel or one of its parts by re-teleporting the source onto the anchor pose every frame after the vehicle solver has finished

title: gatOS
description: A KSA mod that boots a real Alpine Linux in a QEMU microVM beside the game, exposes live telemetry and controls as a 9P /sim filesystem plus HTTP, MQTT, MCP and serial APIs, and adds programmable camera, paint, decal, audio and physics features on top

title: Custom stage delta-v estimator
description: A self-contained per-stage rocket-equation estimate that walks staging sequences, subtracts decoupled subtrees, sums engine thrust at a chosen ambient pressure and claims each reachable tank once through the resource manager's consumption order

title: Minimal mod.toml, post-build deploy and release zip
description: Ships a one-line mod.toml that relies on StarMap's default entry assembly, copies the mod DLL and the ModMenu attribute DLL into the mods folder after each build, and commits a three-file release zip under dist/

title: Draw-list line graph
description: A self-contained time-series chart drawn entirely with ImDrawList primitives, with nice-number axis ticks, a time axis, area fill, min/max/now markers, a dashed alert threshold line and a hover crosshair tooltip, without ImPlot

title: Draw-list widget kit with pop-out sections
description: A small immediate-mode widget library that lays out rows, tiles, gauges, toggles and buttons by hand on the window draw list with InvisibleButton hit-testing and a running y cursor, plus collapsible sections that can be popped out into their own ImGui windows and docked back

title: Editor panel injected into the vehicle editor
description: A Harmony postfix on VehicleEditor.OnDrawUi draws a KER-style analysis window every editor frame, reading the craft under construction from EditingSpace.Parts and the home body's gravity and atmosphere

title: Flight HUD on the controlled vehicle
description: A Harmony postfix on Vehicle.OnDrawUi, filtered to the controlled vehicle in the main viewport, gathers orbit, thrust, TWR, mass, acceleration and staging data once per frame into a shared frame record and draws a sectioned ImGui HUD from it

title: HUD stat tiles and threshold alerts
description: A player-ordered set of up to nine stat tiles and twelve threshold alert rules evaluated against one per-frame context record, surfaced as a warning banner, outlined tiles, warning-coloured rows and a dashed threshold line on the history graph

title: JSON settings with autosave
description: Lazily loads a System.Text.Json settings file from Documents on the first UI frame and re-serialises the live static state at most every two seconds, writing only when the JSON text changed, with late-registered UI sections picking up their saved state on construction

title: Live and rated engine thrust with TWR
description: Reads actual thrust and mass flow from the applied rocket-nozzle states of active engines, rated full-throttle thrust at an ambient pressure from RocketControllerData or Vehicle.ComputeActiveThrust, and turns both into TWR against gravity computed for any body and altitude

title: ModMenu entry with a standalone menu fallback
description: Registers a "Kitten Engineer Redux" menu with ModMenu through the attribute's active-flag property and, when ModMenu does not claim it, draws the same toggles itself from a postfix on the game's empty Program.DrawProgramMenusHook

title: Native stage performance readout
description: Reads per-stage delta-v, thrust, Isp and masses from the game's own staging simulator (PartTree.PerformanceSequences), derives burn time and max TWR from its burn phases, and falls back to a custom estimate while the cache is dirty

title: Orbit readouts and Hohmann estimate
description: Derives apsis altitudes, period, apsis and node countdowns, eccentricity vector, orbit normal, vertical and horizontal surface speed and latitude/longitude from the vehicle's Orbit, and estimates a coplanar Hohmann transfer to a target circular altitude

title: Suicide-burn calculator
description: Estimates the altitude, duration and countdown for a last-moment full-thrust landing burn from radar altitude, surface-relative velocity, active-engine thrust at the live ambient pressure and an averaged gravity term

title: Telemetry history and CSV export
description: Samples six flight metrics every 0.25 s of wall-clock player time into fixed 720-entry arrays from the HUD draw, resets on vehicle change, and writes the window to a timestamped CSV under the mod's Documents data folder

title: Kitten Engineer Redux
description: Small StarMap mod in the spirit of Kerbal Engineer Redux that adds a staging and mass analysis panel to the vehicle editor and a configurable flight HUD with orbit, suicide-burn, planner, alert and telemetry-graph sections, all drawn from Harmony postfixes on the game's own UI methods

title: Continued fork with a new mod id and the old assembly name
description: KittenExtensions Continued installs under the new mod id KittenExtensionsContinued but keeps the KittenExtensions assembly name and namespace, so dependents keep binding through a non-optional StarMap dependency that imports that assembly

title: Custom XML asset types via KxAsset attributes
description: Any loaded assembly that declares its own KittenExtensions.KxAsset or KxAssetInject attribute gets its tagged classes added as new XML element names through XmlAttributeOverrides and a rebuild of every cached game serializer

title: Combined GameData XML document
description: Before the game reads any mod XML, KittenExtensions parses every manifest mod's mod.toml, imports its planet mesh, system, asset and patch files into one in-memory Root/Mod document with a RelPath on each file root, and runs every Patch in manifest order

title: ImGui tree view widget
description: ImGuiTreeView<N, A> draws large trees with custom arrows, guide lines and selection fills on a split draw list, keeps open state in ImGui storage and uses static abstract adapters for node equality and parents

title: MSBuild-generated mod.toml and deploy
description: CopyOutput.targets regenerates mod.toml on every build from MSBuild properties and items, then replaces Release/<ModName> and the installed mod folder, while KSADLLs.props globs the game DLLs as non-private references

title: Patch debug stepper
description: With debug = true on the KittenExtensionsContinued manifest entry, startup dumps the unpatched GameData document to root.xml and opens an ImGui debugger that steps patch actions, tests XPath and browses the live document

title: Patch session log
description: An always-on KittenExtensions.log, reset at StarMapBeforeMain, that hooks the patch executor's events to log every applied or failed document mutation with old and new values and a per-file summary

title: Pre-game ImGui popup loop and fatal patch errors
description: KittenExtensions shows its debugger and fatal error dialog before the game loop exists by subclassing KSA.Popup and pumping its own GLFW, ImGui and Vulkan frame in a loop copied from SelectSystem, then exits after a patch error

title: XmlLoader call-site redirect
description: A Harmony transpiler swaps every XmlLoader.Load<T> call in four Mod loader methods for XmlPatcher.Load<T>, which deserializes the patched in-memory node with an override-aware serializer instead of reading the file

title: XML patch files and XPathPatch operations
description: A mod lists patch files under a patches key in its mod.toml, and each Patch file holds XPathPatch operations (Copy, Merge, Delete, If, IfAny, IfNone, With, SetVar) whose XPath 1.0 Path and From expressions select nodes in the combined GameData document

title: KittenExtensions Continued
description: Foundational StarMap library mod that runs XPath patches over one combined XML document built from every installed mod's data files and lets other mods register new XML asset types, by redirecting the game's XmlLoader calls and extending its XmlSerializer overrides

title: Steer an unpowered descent onto a site with angle of attack, using a measured lift curve and an impact Jacobian
description: After a boostback, fly engine-first into the wind and turn the predicted impact miss into a lift request through the velocity Jacobian of a drag-integrated coast prediction, invert the measured lift curve for the angle of attack, and trim out the attitude loop's lag

title: Set apse, match and set inclination with an ecliptic or equatorial reference
description: Impulsive maneuver math on the game's Orbit API for set periapsis/apoapsis, circularize, match inclination and set inclination, planned on the trajectory after the last pending burn

title: Remove the last finished Auto burn
description: Remove the completed burn that stock keeps when it is the last one in the plan, acting in a RaisePendingAlerts postfix so it never races stock's own removal

title: Automatic staging that keeps Auto burns alive
description: A per-vehicle state machine sampled before and evaluated after the vehicle-solver apply stages on burnout, cascades through empty rows, refuses to drop the last control module, and takes back the stock out-of-propellant stop so an Auto burn survives the staging

title: A custom gauge button action backed by a mod enum
description: Register a mod-defined enum in GaugeButtonFlightComputer.EnumTypes at immediate load, add a Button to the stock EngineControl gauge with a KittenExtensions XML patch, and give the enum toggle, lit and disabled state through Vehicle patches

title: Booster boostback with a drag-integrated impact predictor
description: Adopt a separated booster as its own guided vehicle, predict its impact point by integrating gravity and drag in a co-rotating atmosphere, and fly a receding-horizon boostback burn plus an engine-first glide that walks the impact onto the landing site

title: Build a KSA mod in CI from private reference assemblies
description: Strip the installed game's managed DLLs to API-only reference assemblies with Refasmer, keep them in a private bucket keyed by game build, fetch them in CI by the TestedGameVersion constant, and publish nightlies that are promoted to releases without rebuilding

title: Closed-loop MPC harness and solve-purity checks without the game
description: A console harness that flies the 6-DOF planner closed-loop through RK4 dynamics with injected thrust and gimbal errors to measure plan jump, path ratio and solve cost, plus determinism and threading checks that gated the worker-thread move

title: Minimum-propellant ascent planned offline with SCvx and flown against air-relative speed
description: Build a 3-DOF ascent problem from the vehicle on the main thread as plain data, solve it with successive convexification and Clarabel on its own thread, publish an immutable plan, and fly its pitch and azimuth against air-relative speed until UPFG takes over

title: Plan a deorbit to a landing site and let stock Auto fly the node
description: A time-sliced Lambert search to an approach point uprange of a rotating site, run as a C# iterator under a per-step and total work budget, then a stock maneuver node whose ignition timing stock computes before AFC arms Auto, followed by braking re-planned from the measured orbit

title: Measure a vehicle's drag table by calling the game's force function on a state copy
description: Copy the vehicle's physics state structs, set the airspeed per sample, call the static PhysicsStates.ComputeDerivatives with dt 0 and no thrusters, and fit Cd and CL over Mach and angle of attack, so planners use whatever drag model is active, including aero mods

title: Thrust at ambient pressure, the structural throttle cap and thrust-to-throttle inversion
description: Evaluate active engines through the game's own core model at a given throttle and pressure, mirror the flight computer's g-load throttle cap, and invert a thrust demand into a throttle with a bracketed root find that reports saturation and solid-motor states

title: Feature-gated Harmony patch sets with rollback
description: One Harmony instance per feature, validated before patching and rolled back on failure, so a game update disables one feature instead of the whole mod

title: One ComputeControl postfix as an actuator command sink
description: A single postfix on FlightComputer.ComputeControl runs every mod-owned actuator writer on the vehicle worker and merges their wake and off-rails requests into the stock output

title: Reach the physics worker through the references FlightComputer.CopyFrom shares
description: Publish per-vehicle commands keyed by the BurnPlan and VehicleConfigInfo objects that the worker's flight-computer copy shares with the vehicle, and confine flight-computer writes to the window before the snapshot because the copy is written back at every solver apply

title: Confirm a planned flyby by propagating it through the game's patched conics
description: Propagate a candidate burn with FlightPlan.CalculateBurnPatch and ComputeCompleteTrajectory filtered to the target, read the periapsis of the patch around the target, report a typed reason when there is none, and draw that plan in place of stock's preview

title: Aim a transfer at a flyby periapsis instead of the body center
description: Retarget a stock porkchop transfer by solving Lambert to the target's center offset by the impact parameter that yields the requested periapsis, on a chosen side perpendicular to the approach, and hand the result to the stock Create button

title: Game-free numerical assemblies with console checks against Python references
description: Keep solver and math code in separate assemblies with no game references, so console programs can check them against JAX and CVXPY reference fixtures in CI without the game, and link single game-facing files into small test executables

title: G-FOLD fuel-optimal powered descent solved in-frame with Clarabel
description: Lossless-convexification powered descent as a second-order cone program in a site-fixed frame, solved synchronously with a time limit inside the per-vehicle step and flown as committed-trajectory tracking with periodic re-solves

title: Steer through the stock flight computer with a rate feedforward and direct gimbal commands
description: Command a Custom attitude in an inertial frame, add the commanded turning rate in a postfix on the private FlightComputer.UpdateAttitudeTarget on the physics worker, write least-squares gimbal deflections after ComputeControl, and invert engine performance to deliver a thrust rather than a throttle

title: Guidance flight recorder with per-cycle CSV, plan snapshots and an event log
description: A static, single-owner telemetry sink that never throws or waits on the disk, writing a per-step CSV, rate-limited whole-plan snapshots and an event log per 6-DOF run, plus vehicle-prefixed log lines keyed on a bucketed stage signature

title: A detachable console-window panel and world-space trajectory overlays
description: Draw a mod panel with the game's ConsoleStyle window skin unpinned from the main viewport, gauge-styled tab content, and click-through full-screen overlays that project CCI or body-fixed points through the main camera, all from StarMapAfterGui with fault isolation

title: Per-vehicle autopilot step in a Vehicle.PrepareWorker prefix
description: Run a closed-loop autopilot for every vehicle on the main thread after the player's input is drained and before the flight computer is snapshotted for the physics worker, with per-craft state, takeover checks, fault counting and a menu-bar off switch

title: In-game tests as a separate HeadlessHarness consumer mod
description: Ship tests as a second StarMap mod that depends on HeadlessHarness and the mod under test, discovered by interface and run against the real simulation without a GPU, with API-drift classification, sim-time clocks and test-scoped Harmony owners

title: Transfer Planner targets on hyperbolic orbits
description: Give interstellar comets a mass and SOI with an XML patch, list them as planner targets, and patch the time-of-flight, transfer-window, alignment, intercept and closest-approach code that assumes a finite period, including a finalizer that finishes a method that throws

title: Launch window to a target vehicle's plane, co-elliptic chase orbit and warp to the window
description: Derive the target's plane from its state vectors, time the next ascending or descending crossing of the launch site with a lead for the ascent, aim a co-elliptic orbit below the target, and request the warp through the game's InputEvents.AutoWarpBuffer

title: MSBuild deploy and packaging for a StarMap mod with native payload
description: Shared MSBuild targets that copy a mod into the game's mods folder with a running-game check, a launch profile and a worktree stamp, plus an explicit payload list that drives both deployment and a Release zip verified file by file

title: Sections on the stock Mods settings page
description: A one-call transpiler on GameSettings.OnDrawUi inserts a section host before the page's PopWidgetStyle, and draws registered sections only while the private Mods tab is open

title: Split a maneuver into passes with a forward-chained flight plan
description: Allocate a maneuver's delta-v to N passes by equal burn time or equal delta-v from a private staging model, then chain FlightPlan.CalculateBurnPatch pass by pass so every later pass is placed on the orbit the earlier passes produce

title: Multi-pass execution as a per-vehicle state machine on stock Auto burns
description: Fly a split maneuver hands-free by placing one stock burn per pass, advancing when stock ends a pass, re-arming Auto through Vehicle.SetEnum once the next queued burn has materialized, and surviving saves, propellant stops and player edits

title: Multi-pass Hohmann departures with a period schedule and a shifted window
description: Raise apoapsis in periapsis kicks whose orbital periods sum to a whole number of parking periods so the final kick lands on the transfer window, shifting a same-parent window forward and re-solving Lambert when there is not enough time

title: Draw several predicted orbits with a brightness ramp and custom map markers
description: Render one FlightPlan per planned pass through FlightPlan.AddLineInstances with per-pass dimmed orbit colors, draw apsis, node and SOI markers on the viewport's overlay draw list, and cache the expensive previews behind quantized vehicle-state keys

title: Ship and call native solver libraries from a mod
description: Load clarabel_c and scs from beside the mod assembly with a single module-initializer DllImportResolver per platform, bind them with layout-exact structs, reuse sparse CSC patterns across solves, and keep native calls on one thread per solver instance

title: Build vendored native libraries for Windows and Linux and check the ABI against C#
description: Build Clarabel with cargo and SCS with zig cc from vendored sources with pinned, hash-verified toolchains, and compare the C# struct layouts and export list against a C probe compiled from the same headers on each target platform

title: Optional KittenExtensions XML patches from mod.toml
description: Declare XML patch files in mod.toml and KittenExtensions as an optional StarMap dependency, so data patches apply when it is installed and the code-side features degrade cleanly when it is not

title: Entries in the stock orbit right-click menu
description: A transpiler on BurnContextMenu.Draw inserts a submenu before the popup's final EndPopup and appends entries to the "At Periapsis" and "At Apoapsis" submenus, found by reading the UTF-8 label literals from the IL

title: Inject UI and swap calls inside the stock plan window with anchored transpilers
description: One transpiler pipeline on TransferPlanner.DrawPlanWindow inserts a draw call before two IL anchors, filters the Create button's result with a click gate, and swaps the Burn.Create call site for a same-signature replacement, moving labels and exception markers correctly

title: Create a stock maneuver node from a computed impulse
description: Turn an impulsive delta-v at a time into a stock Burn with Burn.Create on the right flight-plan patch and queue it through InputEvents.BurnUpdateBuffer exactly as the Transfer Planner does, so stock Auto, saves and the burn editor treat it as a normal node

title: Preview a planned burn's trajectory with the game's own orbit lines
description: Build a FlightPlan for a candidate burn with OrbitalTransfers.BuildFlightPlan, draw it in a TransferPlanner.OnPreRender postfix with FlightPlan.AddLineInstances, and suppress stock's selected-transfer preview while a replacement is shown

title: Main-thread vehicle tick right after the solver apply
description: A prefix and postfix on Universe.ApplyVehicleSolvers give mod state machines one main-thread tick per frame with fresh physics results, before input is drained and before stock reacts to burn flags

title: RCS options in the burn editor and a re-enabled Auto gauge button
description: Postfixes add per-burn RCS settings to the stock burn editors (gauge-styled when docked, plain ImGui when detached) and rewrite the Auto gauge button's disabled bits and tooltip for engineless vehicles

title: RCS-only burn execution through the stock Auto button
description: Intercept the Auto burn-mode request, drive the burn from a main-thread state machine, hand an immutable command to the vehicle worker keyed by the shared BurnPlan, and end it through the stock completion flags

title: RCS jet selection with axis groups or a linear program
description: Build a live per-thruster force, torque and mass-flow table in the control frame, then fire signed-axis groups or solve a fuel-optimal jet-selection LP with a hand-written simplex

title: Save-scoped TOML registries beside the mod
description: Per-save, per-vehicle execution state lives in TOML files in the mod folder, keyed by save id and vehicle id, loaded and rekeyed by postfixes on UncompressedSave.Load and Write

title: 6-DOF successive-convexification landing as a receding-horizon MPC on a solver thread
description: A rigid-body landing planner re-solved every cycle from the measured state with SCS on a dedicated background thread, with immutable input snapshots, a single result slot, an estimated acceleration bias, a wall-clock budget and a node ladder

title: Dump the in-game solver problem as JSON and replay it offline
description: The convex-ascent request writes the exact problem it built from the live vehicle to plain SI JSON before solving, and a test-console flag re-solves that file offline with a full trace, with round-trip checks keeping old files readable

title: Predict a jettison and drop spent boosters early
description: Predict which parts the next sequence would shed by mirroring Vehicle.Split on its decouplers, and stage early only when that sheds nothing but burnt-out engines and carries off no propellant a retained engine can still use

title: Per-stage thrust, Isp and burn time from the game's staging simulator
description: Turn PartTree.PerformanceSequences, the drain simulation behind the stage menu, into constant-thrust stages for guidance by reading its phases, repairing double-registered engines, merging artificial phase splits and rescaling the burning stage to the craft's real back pressure

title: Staging delays per part variant and per sequence
description: Hold engines and decouplers of a staged row for configurable delays with on-screen countdowns, configured globally per part variant in TOML and per vehicle sequence from a part-window postfix

title: Detect which planned burn stock just ended
description: A prefix on FlightComputer.RaisePendingAlerts captures the completed or propellant-stopped burn in Harmony state before stock clears the flags, and the postfix learns whether EndAutoBurn kept it

title: Stock-styled rows inside game console windows
description: Small wrappers over the game's public ConsoleWidgets and ConsoleStyle reproduce the Transfer Planner's private row helpers, so UI injected into stock windows matches stock fonts, colors and columns

title: Player messages through the game's timed alerts
description: Show transient centred messages with TimedAlert.Create and CreateWarning from main-thread hooks, reuse the game's localized alert strings with the controlled-vehicle variant, and keep worker-thread code from touching the unsynchronized alert list

title: Stand down for a superseded standalone mod and import its settings
description: Detect the standalone mods a merged mod replaces, by a gauge-enum marker their immediate load registers or by a type lookup, keep the built-in copy off or warn, and copy the old mod's TOML settings once on first load

title: Terminal hover and touchdown with keypad nudges
description: A pilot-in-the-loop final descent on a quadratic sink profile with per-axis PID and gravity feedforward, a coast-and-burn mode for engines whose minimum thrust exceeds weight, terrain height below the craft, and touchdown taken from the game's contact flag

title: Custom plan types in the stock Transfer Planner
description: Insert mod entries into TransferPlanner.TransferTypes and take over the window for those keys with a skip-original prefix that redraws the stock window under the same id, title and signature

title: UPFG ascent to orbit on KSA's staging model
description: A double-precision port of Unified Powered Flight Guidance flown once per guidance second, fed with a stage list built from the game's own SequencePerformance phases at live ambient pressure, with gravity turn, launch window, co-elliptic chase target, g-limit and staging through AutoStage

title: Validated reflection handles with per-feature tags
description: A single class resolves every private game member once, tags each handle with the features that need it, and lets each feature refuse to load when one of its handles is gone

title: Vehicle control ownership, takeover detection and hand-back
description: Main-thread claims per vehicle, a burn-mode hold that mirrors Vehicle.SetEnum, and attitude takeover detection by comparing the exact fields the flight computer reads, so automation yields to the player and restores only what it changed

title: Convert a vehicle's state into a landing-site frame through the game's own transforms
description: Build a local site frame from CCI, derive the model's body axes from the measured engine thrust direction, and convert attitude by transforming basis vectors with KSA's own quaternion so no quaternion convention is ever assumed

title: Warn-once logging, debug switches and a perf scope
description: Thread-safe once-per-key warnings, throttled diagnostics, compile-time per-feature debug switches and a DEBUG-only stopwatch scope keep a large mod's log readable

title: AdvancedFlightComputer
description: Maneuver quick-tools, flyby targeting and multi-pass burns in the stock Transfer Planner, RCS-only burns, automatic staging and burn removal, hyperbolic targets, and closed-loop powered guidance for ascent, boostback and landing with native convex solvers

title: Always-on ImGui hook from a Program.OnFrameEditor postfix
description: Patches the private Program.OnFrameEditor with a Harmony postfix to get the earliest point of every flight frame's ImGui frame, one that still runs when the player hides the UI and that StarMap's own GUI hooks do not offer

title: Spatiotemporal blue-noise dithering
description: Samples a 64-slice spatiotemporal blue-noise (STBN) texture stacked into a 128x8192 PNG, picking the slice from a C#-supplied time value, to add per-pixel, per-frame grain that hides banding in the post-processed image

title: Custom TTF font in the ImGui atlas
description: Adds a bundled TTF from the mod folder straight to ImGui's font atlas at StarMapImmediateLoad, then draws at several sizes from that single font with ImGui 1.92's PushFont(font, size), bypassing KSA's FontManager

title: Surface attitude and air data from the controlled vehicle
description: Computes HUD flight data on the main thread each frame from the controlled Vehicle, including roll/pitch/heading in the local ENU frame, angle of attack and sideslip, vertical speed, g-load, Mach from the body atmosphere, and radar or barometric altitude

title: Fullscreen draw-list HUD
description: Draws a complete fighter HUD (pitch ladder, horizon, flight path marker, heading tape, speed and altitude tapes) as ImGui draw-list geometry in an input-less fullscreen window from a Harmony postfix on Program.OnFrameEditor

title: Canopy-glass post-process chain
description: Three ShaderExtensions PostProcessingShader passes (refracted two-pass Gaussian blur, then a composite with chromatic aberration, edge blur, glowing dirt and grain) that make the IVA scene look as if seen through a canopy

title: Curved, chromatic HUD window via an ImGuiShader
description: Tags the HUD's ImGui draw list with a ShaderExtensions marker callback so the window is rendered offscreen and re-composited through UI_PP_HUD.frag, which barrel-curves it and adds luminance-masked chromatic aberration in IVA view

title: INI settings file and settings window
description: Keeps HUD options in a hand-parsed hud.ini next to the mod DLL, loads it at StarMapImmediateLoad, and edits it from an ImGui settings window drawn in StarMapBeforeGui with toggles, unit menus, color pickers, scale sliders and an explicit save button

title: ModMenu entry with a vendored attributes DLL
description: Lists the mod in the community ModMenu through a static method tagged [ModMenuEntry("Aircraft HUD")], compiling against a ModMenu.Attributes.dll committed to the repo and shipping that DLL next to the mod so StarMap's per-mod load context resolves it

title: Props-based build straight into the mods folder
description: Splits machine-specific build settings into an imported AircraftHUD.props that references the game DLLs by wildcard with Private=False, pulls StarMap.API and Harmony from NuGet, and sets OutputPath to the user's KSA mods folder so every build is a deploy

title: ShaderExtensions push constants and uniform buffers from C#
description: Declares ShaderExtensions' marker attributes locally in the ShaderExtensions namespace so the framework discovers the mod's buffer structs by name, gets lookup delegates injected into static fields, and writes an enabled flag and time value into three per-pass push constants each frame

title: KSA_AircraftHUD
description: Fighter-style head-up display drawn with an ImGui draw list in a fullscreen window, styled by a ShaderExtensions ImGui window shader and backed by a canopy-glass post-process chain, with a custom font, an INI settings file and a ModMenu entry

title: Per-body state ladder and "you are here"
description: Each body becomes a vertical ladder of places (surface, low orbit, stationary, SOI edge, intercept; a 1 AU parking orbit for stars and barycenters) derived from live celestial data, and the controlled vessel's orbit is classified onto it as the route origin

title: Ego-centric re-rooting that follows the controlled vessel
description: Turns the physical celestial tree inside out at the body the vessel is in, climbing a spine of ancestor hub buses, and re-roots on window open, vessel switch, star-system crossing, System menu pick or Shift+click

title: Headless harness tests that run against the real game simulation
description: A test-only StarMap mod depending on HeadlessHarness and DeltaVMap runs IHarnessTest classes on the live game and compares the mod's results with stock code, including private planner methods via reflection

title: Debug-build validation dumps, perf scopes and once-only logging
description: In DEBUG builds the AfterGui hook runs a one-shot delta-v, visual-tree and layout dump (log lines plus SVG/text files) on the first loaded system, ref-struct PerfTracker scopes time the hot paths, and keyed WarnOnce/ErrorOnce logging keeps per-frame failures from flooding the log

title: Interstellar routes and fuel
