description: Prices a trip to another star system as one leg at a chosen cruise speed, using patched-conic gravity-well chains, a Newtonian coast, cheapest and fastest-affordable speed searches, and the game's own antimatter-drive integrator for fuel

title: Live celestial forest of every star system, cached per loaded system
description: Builds one physical tree per independent root (fixed star or barycenter) straight from the loaded CelestialSystem, reads every body's mass, radius, SOI, orbit and atmosphere once, and rebuilds only when Universe.CurrentSystem changes instance

title: Transfer-window markers drawn into the game's 3D map mode
description: While the camera is in map mode it projects each sibling's future position at its next window, the live planet-star-planet phase angle and an ejection-angle gizmo from orbit (CCE) coordinates to screen with the viewport camera's EclToScreen and draws them on the ImGui background draw list

title: Menu-bar entry and stock ImGuiWindow subclass drawn from AfterGui
description: A Harmony postfix on the empty Program.DrawProgramMenusHook adds a top-level menu, and a KSA.ImGuiWindow subclass created lazily from that menu is drawn every frame from StarMapAfterGui

title: Shared MSBuild deploy targets, release zip and SpaceDock publishing
description: A shared ModDeploy.targets deploys into the mods folder with a locked-DLL guard, launch-profile generation and a deploy stamp, and a GitHub workflow publishes release zips to SpaceDock

title: Other star systems as separate graph parts joined by dashed interstellar connectors
description: Cuts the visual tree at its Interstellar edges, lays out each other star system as its own collapsed or expanded part (cached per root build), places the parts in a strip beside the never-moved home map with routed dashed connectors, and keeps the clicked node on screen when a system opens or closes

title: Offline test executable that links the mod's game-free kernels without KSA.dll
description: A console test exe source-links the mod's game-free layout engine and math kernels without KSA.dll, asserts overlaps and formulas against synthetic trees and stock values, and writes SVG dumps

title: Closed-form patched-conic transfer model
description: Hohmann transfers between sibling bodies with Oberth-combined ejection and capture, cached per unordered body pair for the life of a loaded system, plus comet, multiple-star, atmospheric ascent, landing, plane-change and transfer-time terms

title: Route finding and accumulation
description: Click a node to route from "you are here" along the unique tree path (lowest common ancestor), sum the per-leg burns with from-surface, landing, aerobraking, plane-change and return-trip toggles, and show a per-segment breakdown with a display-time piloting margin

title: Search, focus, isolate and minor-body aggregation for dense systems
description: Collapses a hub's minor bodies into one "+N" node above a threshold, folds distant star systems past eight, and lets a body-name search reveal, center and isolate any single body out of thousands, behind an 8,000-node never-hang ceiling

title: Panel rows built on the game's ConsoleWidgets kit
description: The side panels draw toggles, presets, log sliders, readouts and status lines with the game's ConsoleWidgets and ConsoleStyle kit, copying the stock Transfer Planner's slider row

title: Open the stock Transfer Planner preselected on an interstellar plan
description: Binds the private static fields and SetTransferInfo of KSA.TransferPlanner once with AccessTools FieldRef and delegates, then replays the exact writes the stock PLAN TYPE, SOURCE and DESTINATION combos make, degrading to just opening the window when a key is missing

title: Pannable, zoomable ImGui canvas that draws the subway map with draw-list primitives
description: Draws the laid-out map every frame on the window draw list inside a clipped child region, with a full-canvas InvisibleButton that owns drag and wheel, screen-fixed KSP-style node glyphs shared with the legend, per-system colors, priority-ordered label culling and allocation-free cached text

title: Game-free subway-map layout engine with three modes
description: A game-type-free pipeline lays out the delta-v tree as cumulative-down bands, gravity wells on a low-orbit spine, or a Barnes-Hut spring web, measuring labels with ImGui.CalcTextSize

title: Transfer windows list and live polar phase clock
description: For the map root and every shown sibling it computes the Hohmann lead angle, live phase, countdown, synodic period and ejection angle with the same branches as the game's OrbitalTransfers.AlignmentTime, and draws a resizable list plus a polar phase clock whose hover lights the matching map node

title: Vehicle staged delta-v readout
description: Reads the vessel's total staged delta-v from a private instance of the game's SequencePerformanceList, gated by a cheap change signature and a reflected PartTree._derivedDirty check so the UI draw never races the vehicle solver

title: KSA-DeltaVMap (DeltaVMap)
description: An auto-generated, interactive delta-v subway map and transfer-window planner that reads every star system of the loaded universe live, prices routes with closed-form patched conics, and adds an opt-in transfer-window overlay to the game's 3D map mode

title: Snap to bodies and to the edge of their projected disc in the map view
description: One scan projects every body's center and disc radius, snaps inside a disc to the smallest body, snaps the disc-edge band to the limb point toward the cursor, and gates dot-sized bodies on the game's hover-eligibility flag

title: CAD-style snapping: nodes, rim centers, mirror point, vertices, edges and axial/radial components
description: Tiered part snapping (nodes and centers, rim centers and the mirror point, then vertices and edge midpoints, then edge slide, then the raw hull hit) plus axial and radial components for rulers between parts of one vehicle

title: Circle and face-angle tools on part geometry
description: One click on a circular part edge yields a fitted center and rim anchor pair for diameter, radius and circumference; two hull hits yield the live angle between their part-frame normals

title: Own placement clicks with a guarded Program.OnMouseButton prefix
description: A Harmony prefix on Program.OnMouseButton takes unmodified left clicks while armed, pairs each consumed press with its release, defers to popups, ImGui, bindings and editor drags, and restores private mouse latches via reflection

title: Named color palettes persisted to a cfg file next to the mod assembly
description: Overlay colors live in named palettes (four shipped plus user palettes) edited with ColorEdit4, switched from the window menu bar, and saved with a dirty flag to colors.cfg next to the DLL on close and unload

title: Unproject the cursor through the view camera onto a construction plane
description: Free points come from Camera.ScreenToEgoRay intersected with a camera-facing or ecliptic plane through the previous point or a reference body, relying on ego axes being ECL axes and on the ray origin for the editor's orthographic projection

title: Measuring inside the vehicle editor, including parts held in the hand
description: In the vehicle editor the tool scans the editing space and every unattached (in-hand) part tree, anchors to the editing space, lets editor drags keep their left release, and carries part measurements across editor entry and exit

title: Live anchors in body, orbit, surface and part frames
description: Each endpoint is an immutable anchor stored in its owner's frame (body CCE offset, orbit-parent offset, body-fixed lat/lon, part-local asmb) and resolved to ECL every frame, with per-frame pruning and a save-load reset

title: Measure menu and a stock-styled tool window with hover sync and click-to-copy
description: A postfix on the empty Program.DrawProgramMenusHook adds a Measure menu in flight and editor, opening a KSA.ImGuiWindow subclass built from ConsoleWidgets rows whose list syncs hover with the overlay and copies rows to the clipboard

title: Extract feature edges and fit rim circles from a part's triangle list
description: Welds MeshReference.PositionCompare by exact position, keeps boundary, non-manifold and sharp (over 30 degrees) edges, chains them into loops and fits rim circles with a Newell normal and a Kasa fit, cached per shared mesh

title: Shared MSBuild deploy targets, release zip and SpaceDock publishing
description: An imported ModDeploy.targets deploys the DLL and mod.toml with a locked-file check that names the running game, a generated StarMap launch profile and a deploy stamp; a Release zip is published to SpaceDock by a workflow

title: Snap to any visible orbit line with the stock nearest-orbit-point machinery
description: Runs the stock Orbit.GetNearestPosition and OrbitHoverCandidate.Wins over the stock burn picker's candidate set for every body, re-checks winners on screen to close a behind-camera NaN hole, and anchors to the orbit's parent

title: World-space measurement overlay on the ImGui background draw list
description: Draws measurements, previews, snap markers and plated labels into the main viewport's background draw list from StarMapAfterGui, culls behind-camera points, and throttles the hover pick to 45 ms with a state-version check

title: Part-local anchors that survive staging, docking and the editor boundary
description: Part anchors keep their point in the part's asmb frame, resolve to ECL with a camera-free mirror of Vehicle.GetMatrixAsmb2Ego, and are re-homed by finding the same Part object in the editor trees or any vehicle

title: Pick hull points, attach nodes and part centers on vehicles under the cursor
description: Gates vehicles by projected size and bounding sphere, raycasts parts with the stock Part.RayCastEgo over each MeshViewModule triangle list, and scans attach nodes and part centers in screen space, optionally reusing the stock hover

title: Per-patch Harmony application, drift checks, once-only logging and debug perf scopes
description: The entry class applies each Harmony patch class separately, type-checks private reflection targets at load, logs each per-frame exception type once, and in DEBUG builds times hot paths with Stopwatch scopes

title: Surface tool with body-fixed pins, great-circle distance and an occlusion-aware arc
description: Ray-casts the cursor against each celestial's mean-radius sphere, pins hits as body-fixed lat/lon, reports haversine distance, chord and bearing, and draws the great-circle arc while hiding samples on the far hemisphere

title: KSA-MeasureTools (MeasureTools)
description: Click-to-measure ruler, protractor, surface, circle and face-angle tools for the map view, the flight view and the vehicle editor, with snapping to bodies, disc edges, orbit lines and part geometry down to mesh vertices and feature edges

title: Allocation-free formatted readout text
description: Formats every per-frame readout into stackalloc'd char spans with TryFormat and hands the spans straight to draw-list text calls, which Brutal's ImString encodes into a per-frame arena instead of allocating strings

title: Keep drawing while the game UI is hidden
description: Patches the private Program.DrawFps with a Harmony postfix found and applied purely through reflection, because OnFrame calls it outside the DrawUI guard that silences StarMap's UI hooks on F2

title: Engine diagram from real nozzle positions
description: Builds a top-down dot diagram of the active stage by enumerating engine controllers and rocket cores from the part tree and projecting each nozzle into vehicle assembly space, ringed by a propellant arc summed from every tank

title: Error budget and self-disable
description: Wraps every per-frame entry point in try/catch, logs only the first exception of a streak, and after ten consecutive failures disables the whole mod and restores the stock flight HUD so a game update cannot leave the player with a broken screen

title: In-flight event detection and callouts
description: Infers liftoff, max Q, MECO/SECO, stage and booster separation, relights and landing from frame-to-frame deltas of engine, part, vehicle and decoupler counts, and announces them as fading banners

title: Broadcast overlay on the ImGui foreground draw list
description: A full-screen webcast-style bottom bar drawn straight into ImGui's foreground draw list, with anchored panels, a gradient backdrop band and sloped shelf plates, instead of an ImGui window

title: Freeze on signal loss
description: Stops sampling and holds the last telemetry when the controlled vehicle loses control, is destroyed, or is about to exceed its structural g-load or dynamic-pressure limit, showing an acquisition-of-signal notice like a real broadcast

title: Hide and restore the stock flight HUD
description: Disables every enabled, non-AlwaysEnabled GaugeCanvas while the overlay is up and re-enables exactly those afterwards, pausing while the game's LAYOUTS window is open so a saved HUD layout does not record everything as switched off

title: Staged intro and outro animation
description: A time-driven animator that sweeps the overlay in as five overlapping eased stages, staggers gauges from the screen edge inward, plays itself backwards as an outro, and cross-fades engine dots on state changes

title: JSON config in the KSA documents folder
description: Stores settings, colour overrides and tuning overrides in Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/KSATelemetryOverlay/config.json via Constants.DocumentsFolderPath, tolerates hand edits by dropping unreadable fields one at a time, clamps values, and saves debounced and atomically

title: Live flight telemetry sampling
description: Copies speed, altitude, g-load, dynamic pressure, apsides, downrange, thrust and propellant fraction of the controlled vehicle into a plain snapshot object once per frame from StarMapAfterOnFrame, for the UI to draw on the next frame

title: Live tuning window and palette by reflection
description: Exposes every public static float and int of a Tuning class and every colour field of a style class through reflection, so a debug window can edit layout and animation constants live, save only the overrides, and print the changed values back as C# source

title: Mission clock and liftoff detection
description: A T-minus/T-plus clock that keys each mission on the vehicle's LaunchGameTime (shared by every stage split from it), detects the real liftoff moment from contact, power and climb rate, supports a hotkey countdown, and persists liftoff epochs and launch sites in the config

title: Mission timeline with planned burns
description: A scrolling mission timeline centred on now that shows detected events behind the marker and the flight computer's planned maneuver burns ahead of it, read from Vehicle.FlightComputer.BurnPlan each frame and converted to mission time

title: ModMenu entry with a standalone fallback window
description: Declares its own copy of ModMenu's ModMenuEntry attribute on a static settings method so ModMenu can list it under Mods without a dependency, and draws the same settings tree as a hotkey-toggled ImGui window when ModMenu is absent, switching BeginMenu for CollapsingHeader

title: Montserrat fonts in the ImGui atlas
description: Lazily adds bundled Montserrat TTFs to the game's ImGui font atlas on the first UI frame, renders them at arbitrary sizes with the two-argument PushFont, and draws tabular digits and drop shadows on a draw list

title: Every element as its own ImGui window
description: Wraps each overlay panel in a subclass of the game's KSA.ImGuiWindow implementing IStaticWindow, so it is drawn by the game's own static-window pass like stock windows, and persists open state, position and size in the mod config because those windows opt out of imgui.ini

title: Rebindable numpad hotkeys
description: Polls ImGui.IsKeyPressed for numpad toggle, settings and countdown keys stored as ImGuiKey values in the JSON config, skips them while a text field has focus, and rebinds them with a press-a-key capture loop over the ImGuiKey range

title: KSA Broadcast Telemetry Overlay
description: StarMap mod that draws a SpaceX-webcast-style telemetry bar over KSA flight with live gauges, an engine diagram built from real nozzle positions, a mission clock, inferred flight events and planned burns, while hiding and restoring the stock HUD

title: API surface pinning and KSA upgrade diffing
description: Record every KSA type and member the compiled mod binds to from its own metadata tables, pin Harmony targets into that record with never-called PinTheSignature methods, lock the game assemblies by SHA-256, and narrow a KSA update's decompiled diff to what the mod actually touches

title: Art and audio pipeline tooling
description: Offline checks and generators for a mod's authored assets, covering GLB bounds from accessor min/max, coplanar-face and zero-UV detection, atlas dilation, Blender previews, XML Id and path validation against Core, and engine loops cut from CC0 recordings with their provenance

title: Car panel and ModMenu entry
description: A closable ImGui panel drawn from the GUI hook only while a car is flown, built with flags that never take the keyboard so the flight keys keep driving, plus an optional ModMenu entry declared through a name-matched attribute copy

title: Car part assets: GLB atlases, PBR materials and subparts
description: Declare a new part's look in an Assets XML bundle with a MeshAtlas GLB, a PbrMaterial with diffuse, normal, ORM and emissive PNGs, one SubPart template per moving body, a glass subpart, and a Part that instances and places them

title: Car part game data
description: Make a mod part a drivable root craft in GameData XML with its own EditorTagDef category, a node connector, a Control command source, battery and light switch, a box-shaped mass for yaw inertia and colliders that stay clear of the ground at rest

title: Coloured emissive lenses per subpart
description: Make a tail lens glow red and a marker amber by setting KSA's add-emissive-colour state bit and colour per drawn subpart from a Harmony postfix on the private PartTreeRenderData.WriteState, with the lenses cut out of the body mesh as their own subparts

title: Craft mover with mouse picking and ground placement
description: Pick a craft with one click by projecting every vehicle to the screen, find the ground under the cursor by walking a camera ray against the height field, draw gizmo rings anchored to the craft's rendered position, and set the craft down once with Vehicle.TeleportToLocation

title: Veto structural destruction for one kind of craft
description: Spare a car from KSA's crash destruction with a Harmony prefix on Universe.DestroyVehicleFromEvent that returns false for it, and close the separate part-failure path by setting CrashTolerance far past any contact pressure on the car's Part

title: Drive with the flight keys
description: Map a car's throttle, brake, steering and air controls onto KSA's existing vehicle key bindings by reading the craft's held thruster flags, reflected engine switch and throttle keys, and a patched-in sprint key

title: Driver kitten's hands on the steering wheel
description: Attach a custom IAnimProcessor to the seated driver kitten's character model through a reflected private field and solve each arm onto the turning steering-wheel rim with a two-bone IK after the seated animation and before skinning

title: KSA's engine panel and throttle gauge for a craft with no engine
description: Show KSA's own engine-control gauge panel for an engineless car that flies, withhold the "No active engines" alert, and put the mod's throttle on the stock throttle gauge by writing Vehicle._manualControlInputs between the GUI pass and UpdateGauges

title: Engine sound from two crossfaded, re-pitched loops
description: Ship mod-owned engine samples as Sound XML assets and play an idle loop and a loaded loop together on KSA's FMOD channels, crossfaded by throttle and re-pitched every frame to the simulated RPM

title: Volumetric exhaust plumes with no engine behind them
description: Draw KSA's own volumetric rocket plumes at arbitrary nozzles by building VolumetricExhaustInstance objects from a Core template and submitting them from a Harmony postfix on Vehicle.AddVolumetricExhaustInstances, with gas numbers the mod chooses

title: File-drop command bridge
description: Drive a running game from outside by dropping JSON command files into a folder beside the mod's log and reading JSON replies back, polled once a frame from the frame postfix, with multi-frame commands for stepping the world, spawning craft, driving cars and taking screenshots

title: Once-per-frame car step from two StarMap hooks, with a registry of the mod's craft
description: Run per-frame work once from whichever of StarMapAfterGui or StarMapAfterOnFrame fires first, release the latch in a finally on the hook KSA always calls, and keep a per-frame registry of the craft carrying the mod's part

title: Headless simulation tests and the Sim/Ksa boundary
description: Split the mod into a KSA-free Sim folder and a KSA-facing Ksa folder, link Sim wholesale into an xUnit project that references no game assembly, and drive the car model on a rigid-body rig so physics changes are tested without the game, with CI and hooks running the same checks

title: Headlamps and tail lamps as KSA spotlights
description: Submit a car's head and tail lamps as KSA spot lights from a Harmony postfix on PartTree.UpdateRenderData, the only point where per-frame lights survive LightSystem.ClearLights, and keep them in step with the part's own light switch

title: Keep a craft with mod thrust off rails
description: Stop KSA from putting a car onto its orbit while the mod's rockets burn by answering yes to the private PhysicsBubble.KittenWantsWake, the per-craft question both rails decisions ask, and rebuild a coasting car from its orbit before pushing it

title: KSA MCP server over the bridge
description: A stdlib-only Python MCP server, registered in .mcp.json, that turns the mod's file-drop bridge into agent tools for launching, loading, stepping, driving and photographing a running game, returning screenshots inline with contact sheets and temporal-noise maps

title: Launch pad surface contact
description: Rebuild a body's launch-pad colliders from their StaticObjectTemplate data, posed the way ConstraintSim poses them, and drop a ray from each wheel hub onto those boxes and cylinders so a car drives on the pad deck

title: One folder as both a content mod and a StarMap code mod
description: A single mod folder whose mod.toml is read by KSA for its explicitly listed asset XML files and by StarMap for the entry assembly, with the XML at the root beside Meshes, Textures and Sounds and a csproj that copies them next to the DLL

title: Per-mod log file, build stamp and fault limiter
description: Keep the mod's own batched, thread-safe log file beside KSA's logs with the previous session preserved, stamp the KSA build the DLL was compiled for into the assembly, detect developer installs by a marker file, and disable the mod after repeated faults

title: Build, deploy, package and release pipeline
description: Resolve the game's DLLs from a tiered search without committing them, deploy a developer build with a marker file after validating assets, package a symbol-free archive that refuses foreign DLLs, and release with semantic-release, a draft GitHub release and SpaceDock publishing

title: Pose subparts at runtime
description: Animate wheels, suspension arms, squashed coil-overs, the steering wheel, iris blades and scoops by rewriting each subpart's parent-relative transform every frame from the GUI hook, with a frame-postfix fallback when the UI is hidden

title: Inject wheel forces from a Vehicle.PrepareWorker prefix
description: Write a car's per-step linear and angular impulse straight into the vehicle's kinematic state from a Harmony prefix on Vehicle.PrepareWorker, the only main-thread window where the write reaches the physics worker

title: Rocket lift, hover, boost and downforce as velocity deltas
description: Fly a car on thrust the mod applies itself by adding lift, hover, boost and downforce pushes to the vehicle's velocity and spin in the same Vehicle.PrepareWorker window as the springs, written as shares of the step so time warp cannot make them overshoot

title: Rocket roar from KSA's stock engine sound, with no engine
description: Play Core's DefaultEngineSoundBehavior on a channel the mod owns and feed it the Throttle, Distance, Pressure and Iva parameters each frame, exactly as Vehicle.UpdateAudio does for a real nozzle

title: Switchable scoop colliders and rocks that come loose
description: Deploy a scoop blade by moving stowed collider boxes out of the hull at runtime through ColliderModule.PositionPartAsmb and NeedsColliderUpdate, and make ground clutter pushable by lowering BubbleClutterStatics.DisplaceEnergyPerKg, enabling clutter collisions and lightening rock templates

title: Seated crew of unflown cars
description: Postfix Vehicle.UpdateSeatedCrewRenderData so the kittens sitting in every car that is not the controlled vehicle are drawn too, with the same viewport, camera matrix and player step KSA used for the flown craft

title: Seats and EVA doors
description: Give a mod part crew seats with IVASeat entries placed at the kitten's eye, and let kittens get out and climb back in through EVADoor modules on mesh-less hidden subparts beside each seat

title: Spawn a saved craft parked at a latitude and longitude
description: Build a library craft on a placeholder orbit inside ConstraintSim.UnlockShapesBlocking, add it to its parent's Children so per-frame data runs, and set it down with Vehicle.TeleportToLocation

title: Terrain contact under each wheel
description: Find the ground under each wheel hub by sampling the body's height field along the hub's planet-fixed direction, using the vehicle's physics state rather than its analytic orbit position

title: Vehicle library presets
description: Install each car as a ready-to-launch whole craft by writing a vehicle.xml with a single RootPartRef and a meta.toml into the player's Vehicles library, mirroring Core's default vehicles

title: Wheel, suspension and tyre model
description: A per-wheel spring-damper with anti-roll bars, a friction-circle tyre, a speed-limited steering lock, a linear drive-force falloff and a cosmetic gearbox, stepped once a frame as one impulse for the whole car

title: KSACars (Fast & Purrious)
description: Driveable cars for KSA, a beach buggy and a flying Cadillac Eldorado, built as single parts whose springs, tyres, engine, rockets, lights, sounds and driver animation are simulated by a StarMap code mod and injected into the engine's vehicle step

title: Aero readout window
description: An auto-sized ImGui window drawn from StarMapAfterGui that finds the controlled vehicle, reads its main-thread atmosphere and kinematic state and re-runs the physics model to show Mach, q, angle of attack, lift and drag

title: Body-of-revolution aerodynamics
description: Replaces stock bounding-box drag with an axisymmetric cylinder model that gives angle-of-attack drag, lift with a stall, tail-first lift and a transonic drag rise, evaluated per substep inside the vehicle solver

title: ComputeDrag call-site transpiler
description: A Harmony transpiler on PhysicsStates.ComputeDerivatives that retargets only the atmospheric ComputeDrag call to a same-signature replacement, found by scanning the call's argument IL for the AtmosphericDensity load

title: Game version check
description: At StarMapAllModsLoaded the mod compares VersionInfo.Current.VersionString with the build it was tested on and logs a warning on mismatch, leaving the real go or no-go decision to the transpiler's shape check

title: Headless model tests
description: A console project that source-links the game-free AeroModel.cs, checks physical invariants of the aero model over thousands of attitudes and Mach numbers, and prints coefficient tables, all without KSA installed

title: Mach number from the game atmosphere
description: Derives the speed of sound as sqrt(1.4 p / rho) from the pressure and density KSA already stores per vehicle, which is a per-body constant because KSA atmospheres are isothermal exponentials

title: Build and deploy targets
description: An MSBuild setup that compiles against the installed game's DLLs via a KsaDir property, takes Harmony and StarMap.API from NuGet, deploys the DLL and mod.toml into the KSA mods folder on every build with a locked-file diagnosis and a deploy stamp, and zips a release

title: Patch refusal and rollback
description: KSAero throws from its own transpiler when the target method has changed shape, then catches the failure, removes only its own Harmony patches by id and leaves the stock behaviour and its UI switched off

title: Stock ComputeDrag delegate fallback
description: A typed delegate with matching in and ref parameters, created once with AccessTools.MethodDelegate, lets the replacement force function call the private stock PhysicsStates.ComputeDrag whenever it cannot model the vehicle

title: KSAero
description: Small StarMap mod that replaces stock atmospheric drag with a body-of-revolution lift and drag model by rewriting one call site in the vehicle force function

title: API surface record and assembly lock
description: Pinning the KSA build a mod compiles against with a hash lock, recording the exact game members the compiled DLL binds to from its metadata tables, and narrowing each KSA update to the changes that can affect the mod

title: Borrowing the main view and handing it back
description: KSA-free rules for borrowing the player's main view: who may hold it, a hand-back in two halves (mode and follow) with the field of view always returned, a chase pose, KSA-style orbit drag, a carried roll and an evened-out step

title: Content-plus-code mod layout
description: One mod folder that KSA loads as a content mod (asset XML, meshes, textures, sounds) and StarMap loads as a code mod, built so the game assemblies are referenced but never shipped

title: Course colliders registered as ground clutter
description: Static Bepu boxes added to every nearby physics bubble from worker-thread prefixes on ConstraintSim and registered by reflection as infinite-mass ground clutter, the only kind of mod-made static the engine lets a kitten stand on

title: Course grid model and JSON save file
description: An engine-free minigolf course model with ports as cell edges, an append-only piece catalogue with non-rectangular footprints and mirror twins, a playability check, port snapping, undo and redo, and a versioned JSON file anchored by latitude, longitude, heading and height above ground

title: Course surface from exact shapes
description: The minigolf course as the ball meets it, built from exact rail boxes, posts, felt heights and cup profiles shared with the Blender models, with rails swept rather than sampled and the planet's ground beyond the pieces

title: Craft mover
description: Click a craft to pick it up and click the ground to set it down, or send the flown craft to any body, through Vehicle.TeleportToLocation so the engine rebuilds an upright resting state from the craft's bounding box

title: Cursor picking and the terrain ray
description: Turning the ImGui cursor into a world ray through the right viewport's camera, walking that ray to the first place it goes under the terrain, and picking the craft nearest the cursor on screen with a per-item reach

title: Degrading Harmony patches with per-feature ids and signature pins
description: One static class per Harmony patch, each under its own Harmony id, looking its target up defensively, logging once and standing down instead of throwing, pinned into the API record by a never-called call, and removed by a fault limit rather than by StarMapUnload

title: Developer panel and menu-bar entry
description: An ImGui panel reached from an entry in ImGui's own main menu bar opened before KSA's GUI pass (a separate bar from KSA's), an optional ModMenu entry through a copied attribute, a floating reopen button, wrapped tooltips and slow-motion controls

title: Dual-hook frame stepping on simulated time
description: Running a mod's per-frame simulation exactly once per frame from whichever of three hooks reaches it first (the GUI postfix, a Harmony prefix on Program.OnFrameCelestials, or the frame postfix), latched and always released, and integrated on the engine's applied sim step rather than player time

title: File command bridge and MCP server
description: Driving a running game from outside through JSON command files dropped beside the log and answered in an outbox, gated to developer installs, with a stdlib MCP server that turns the commands into agent tools

title: First-person kitten view that keeps the shadow
description: Look out through a kitten's eyes by stripping its skeleton for the main view only, re-skinning the whole kitten into the shadow pool, holding its walking facing on the mouse look, and posing the eye from the head bone each frame

title: Frame and epoch draw anchor
description: Drawing world-space gizmos next to a craft without the 500 m-per-frame ecliptic error, by anchoring every overlay to the craft's rendered Ego position sampled this frame and adding Ecl offsets measured against the platform sample from the simulation step

title: GLB authoring pipeline and mesh checks
description: Authoring KSA meshes live in Blender over MCP with a human geometry sign-off, an export contract checked against Core's atlases, and offline Python checkers that catch zero-UV-area faces, coplanar z-fighting, unmaterialed primitives and bad asset references before the game ever loads them

title: Golf ball physics in the body-fixed frame
description: A mod-simulated golf ball integrated in the rotating body-fixed frame of the world under it, with flight, bounce, rolling resistance, slope rest and quadratic drag scaled by the engine's own air and sea density

title: Headless simulation tests behind a Sim/Ksa boundary
description: Splitting the mod into a KSA-free Sim folder linked wholesale into an xUnit project and a Ksa folder that binds to the game, so the maths runs headlessly and the boundary enforces itself at build time

title: Mod meshes held by a kitten as cosmetic attachments
description: Hang a mod's own glTF on a kitten bone at runtime by adding it to CharacterAvatar.Attachments.CosmeticAttachments, building the StaticMeshRenderable the way the engine builds Core's, with the material slot filled first and an optional see-through visor-glass technique

title: Posing kitten bones through the pose-processor list
description: Turn, move or stretch any bone of a live EVA kitten by adding an IAnimProcessor to its AnimatedRenderable.AnimProcessors list, reached through one reflection hop to the private avatar

title: Launch-site surface by raycast into a copied collider
description: A Harmony prefix on Universe.ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers copies each launch site's Bepu compound collider and terrain-tagged model triangles while the shapes registry is unlocked, so the ball can ray-cast straight down onto the apron, pad and drawn road at any time

title: Level-horizon camera controller swapped into the main viewport
description: Subclass KSA's FixedController to supply a rate-limited up vector, re-pose the view inside the viewport pass and take mouse input, installed by a checked reflection write into a get-only backing field

title: Top-down minigolf course builder
description: A B-key build mode that turns the main view straight down over a body-fixed course grid, picks the cell under the cursor, snaps a ghost piece onto open ports, and places, moves, removes, undoes and saves pieces while taking the keys and clicks away from the kitten
hooks: subclass KSA.FixedController (OnKey, OnMouseButton, OnScroll, IsMouseDrag overrides)

title: Mod log file with rotation and a verbose toggle
description: A per-mod log file beside KSA's own logs, truncated each session with the previous session kept as a prev log, batched writes with a flush timer, and a runtime Debug toggle instead of a debug build

title: Drawing a mod's static mesh into every viewport
description: Postfix SuperMeshRenderSystem.ClearBuckets so a mod's own StaticMeshRenderable (the ball, course pieces, a see-through ghost) is submitted after the engine clears each viewport's mesh buckets, the one moment such a draw survives to the render

title: Packaging, deploy and release pipeline
description: One portable net10.0 archive for Windows and Linux with gates against shipping symbols or game DLLs, a deploy script that installs and registers the mod, and semantic-release plus SpaceDock publishing driven by Conventional Commits

title: Prop and course asset XML
description: Declaring a mod's own meshes and PBR materials as standalone GltfFile and PbrMaterial assets, drawn by code instead of being built as parts, static objects or clutter

title: Putting address pose drawn on the kitten skeleton
description: Draw a kitten stepped up to the ball, bent at the waist with both arms aimed at the grip, by carrying the skeleton's root bones in a pose processor while the physics body stays where the player walked it, and place the club against each view's own wrist

title: Putting session with a mouse-swung club
description: The flown kitten carries a putter, drops a ball, steps up to it with G and swings with the mouse, the session tying the drawn pose, the borrowed view, the simulated ball and the strike sound together across the frame

title: Save-load detection
description: Detecting that a save was loaded, which StarMap has no hook for and which never leaves the flight scene, with a latched Harmony postfix on Program.OnGameLoaded consumed by the next simulation step

title: Swept contact against a craft's real hull
description: Analytic swept contact for a fast small body, with a bounding sphere as broad phase and a per-triangle ray cast through Part.RayCastEgo as the narrow phase, falling back to the sphere rather than to a miss

title: Terrain height queries off the engine's height field
description: How KSAGolf asks the engine where the ground is, through one Celestial height query wrapped as a ground test, a height-field seam, a ridge mask, a slope reading and a local east/north frame, with the sea clamped in

title: Visual testing captures
description: Scripted screenshots through KSA's own ScreenshotCapture reached by reflection, with a UI-free warm-up, per-picture JSON manifests carrying the craft's projected screen position, simulated-time series, same-instant variant diffs and a temporal noise map

title: World-positioned sounds
description: Shipping wav files as Sound assets in a mod's XML and playing them at an arbitrary world point through GameAudio.PlaySound, anchored on a nearby vehicle for Doppler and air pressure

title: KSAGolf
description: A golf mod foundation for Kitten Space Agency with a working putting game and a minigolf course builder on top of extensive frame-timing, camera, kitten-posing, terrain and developer tooling

title: Analytic sub-frame fuses by closest approach
description: Proximity, contact, timed, height and ground fuses are solved in closed form inside each integration sub-step, so a round at kilometres per second cannot step over its trigger radius and the burst instant is known to a fraction of the step

title: Record the exact KSA API a mod binds to from its compiled metadata
description: A small System.Reflection.Metadata tool lists every KSA type and member the built mod references, committed as a generated document, checked in CI and used to narrow a KSA update's decompiled diff to what can actually break

title: A three-member, text-only registration API for code packs, with a generated contract record
description: KSArmory exposes Armoury.Register(string, string) so a dependent StarMap mod can add weapons from its entry point using only KSArmory.dll, returns faults instead of throwing, closes the door at StarMapAllModsLoaded, and guards the contract with a generated surface file that CI diffs

title: Articulated turrets by rewriting subpart transforms every frame
description: A single editor part traverses, elevates, recoils and spins its barrels because the mod finds named subparts at runtime and writes their parent-relative position, rotation and scale from rate-limited drives each frame

title: Blast damage per part against the engine's crash tolerance, with health and engine dents
description: A burst judges every part of every craft on its own distance and the engine-derived Part.CrashTolerancePascals, charges a persistent per-part health ledger, queues the parts that break, and hands the loads short of breaking to KSA's own dent system when the blast front arrives

title: Push a craft with a blast wind by writing an impulse into its physics state
description: Each part the blast front reaches adds a drag-style push and a torque about the centre of mass, saturated so nothing outruns the wind, and the summed impulse is written into the vehicle's kinematic state from the PrepareWorker prefix the way Vehicle.Split does it

title: Headless Blender model generation and offline GLB checks
description: Three parts are generated by a headless Blender script into one palette-textured GLB atlas, and Python checkers that need neither Blender nor the game catch z-fighting, zero-area UVs, unpaired node names, swept collisions and launch geometry that has drifted from the C# profiles

title: Borrow the player's main view and hand it back
description: Mod camera owners borrow KSA's main view by recording its follow target, mode and field first, ranking claims with a pure ViewClaim ladder, standing down when the player changes either half, and restoring the halves separately
hooks: harmony-postfix KSA.Program.OnGameLoaded (save load, consumed in StepOnce)

title: Deploy into the KSA mods folder, package a clean archive and cut releases from commits
description: Scripts that build and install the mod with its manifest.toml registration and a developer marker, package an archive that refuses any DLL but the mod's own, and a semantic-release pipeline that drafts a GitHub release, attaches the archive and republishes it to SpaceDock

title: Shell holes held in the struck sub-part's frame and painted from depth
description: Shell hits found with Part.RayCastEgo are stored in the struck sub-part's own frame and carried to the camera through the matrix the engine draws that sub-part with, and the newest 400 are painted as procedural holes and soot by one tile-gathered compute dispatch before bloom

title: A burst's whiteout and a blast front's view shake, painted into the scene image instead of moving the camera
description: A nuclear flash whites out the view on an eye-adaptation model and a passing blast front shakes it, both stepped on the simulated clock and written by compute dispatches into the HDR scene before bloom, never into a camera

title: The burst's bang, played when its blast front reaches the listener
description: The nuclear preset ships without Core's SoundEvent, and the mod follows each burst's blast front out to the audio camera, then plays Core's ExplosionBig itself, pitched by yield, as loud as the pressure there, with coincident bursts merged

title: Chase camera riding a mod-simulated round
description: The main view follows a round through a custom IFollowable that reports the round's drawn position, on a reflection-installed FixedController subclass that adds an up vector and re-solves the pose inside the engine's viewport pass

title: A mod compute pass recorded into KSA's frame just before bloom
description: One Harmony prefix on the public SunbloomRenderer.Render hands the mod KSA's command buffer while the HDR scene colour is in a storage layout and depth is sampleable, and the mod dispatches its own Shader-asset compute pipelines there through KSA's ComputePipelineWrapper

title: Gun tracers added into the scene by one tiled compute dispatch
description: Gun rounds are projected on the CPU into screen-space segments in a host-visible storage buffer when the pass records, and one compute dispatch gathers them per 16x16 tile and adds depth-tested tracer streaks before bloom, with gizmo lines as the fallback

title: Integrate on the step KSA applied, consumed once
description: The mod advances its own simulation by Universe.GetLastSimStep, deduplicated on the step's NextTime and widened to the span since the last step it integrated, never by the player-time delta StarMap passes

title: A generated include that reaches KSA's own shader library from a mod shader
description: At StarMapImmediateLoad the mod writes Shaders/Content/CoreAtmosphere.glsl with absolute includes of the install's Global, AtmosphereLuts and TextureSet headers, so its compute shaders compile against KSA's atmosphere code without copying it, and a glslang script checks them offline the same way

title: Flare and chaff dispenser parts with simulated decoys
description: Radial ALE-47 dispenser parts throw mod-simulated flares and chaff in timed salvos, by button or missile warning, and each decoy flies as a dragged point with a fading signature that feeds the radar's chaff notch and seekers that judge each decoy once

title: Closest-point-of-approach threat classification
description: Contacts are classed as threats by where straight-line relative motion takes them within a horizon, not by closing speed, then ranked by time to closest approach, with a closing-only rule for munitions and a median-filtered acceleration kept beside each track

title: Cursor-ray picking and world click tools
description: The ImGui cursor becomes an Ecl ray through the viewport under it (Camera.ScreenToEgoRay), hit-tested against hulls (Part.RayCastEgo) and terrain, driving fire-at-spot, shift-click lock and test-burst tools guarded by WantCaptureMouse and still run when the UI is hidden

title: Targeting rings painted on the depth buffer
description: Sight, reach, designation and ICBM target rings are collected in the UI pass anchored to their body and painted before bloom by one compute dispatch per ring that rebuilds the scene point from depth and draws an exact circle or ellipse with a fixed pixel-width line

title: Detect a save load with a postfix on Program.OnGameLoaded
description: A one-line Harmony postfix on the public static Program.OnGameLoaded latches a flag that the next simulation step consumes to drop every round, system, effect and clock boundary belonging to the world the save replaced

title: Director camera windows on leased secondary viewports
description: An optical director leases one of KSA's four spare viewports, aims its unfollowed Fixed camera with LookAt from the GUI hook, hides KSA's own window by reflection and shows the viewport texture in a mod ImGui window with pod controls

title: One simulation step per frame from whichever hook runs first
description: A frame latch hands the mod's step to the StarMap GUI postfix when the HUD is drawn, to a by-name Harmony prefix on Program.OnFrameCelestials when F2 or a screenshot hides it, and to the OnFrame postfix as a last resort

title: One ecliptic frame and one epoch for everything simulated and drawn
description: All mod state lives in KSA's ecliptic frame at Universe.GetElapsedTime(), targets are back-dated to the round's sub-step instant, and drawing goes through the engine's own Camera.GetPositionEgo so overlays and bursts land where the craft is rendered

title: Drive a running game from outside through a file command bridge and an MCP server
description: A developer-only bridge polls a folder beside the mod log for JSON commands (pause, step, burst, camera, capture, shader reload, spawn, fly), answers each atomically in a second folder, and a stdlib Python MCP server turns that folder into tools that return captures inline to an agent

title: Fire control ladder and per-craft target allocation
description: Each weapon system decides once per simulated step whether to launch through an ordered ladder of named gates (platform, magazine, lock, drives, IFF, gimbal, salvo, envelope) that also reports why it holds, counting rounds per target per craft from what is in the air

title: Fireball light through LightDebug, filled in where the light pre-pass dropped it
description: A nuclear fireball's point light is pushed into KSA's light system through the public LightDebug list, and a compute dispatch before bloom adds its diffuse term on craft and structures the clustered pre-pass culled beyond about 3 km, found by reading the pre-pass irradiance image by reflection

title: Fly any vehicle from a mod through its flight computer and input actions
description: Another craft is flown through the flight computer's Custom attitude target, keyboard actions sent with Vehicle.ProcessInput and its staging sequence, with attitude and staging written from the PrepareWorker prefix so the worker snapshot sees them, then handed back

title: World-anchored overlays through KSA's gizmo renderer
description: Radar cones, track markers, round trails, shell streaks and placement markers drawn as GizmosRenderer spheres and lines from the StarMap GUI postfix, anchored to the engine's own render position for the platform

title: Designate a place on the ground that moves with the planet, and show what a falling store can still reach
description: A click on terrain becomes a Ground aimpoint stored in the body's own fixed frame and re-read into ecliptic position and velocity (orbit plus spin) every frame, and a falling guided store's remaining reach is flown and drawn so a click is either a correction or the next aim
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via StepOnce and the GUI pass)

title: Guided bomb tail kit and a flown bomb sight
description: A falling store steers by predicting its own landing and pushing square to its airflow to move that landing onto a ground designation, while the bomb sight flies a throwaway copy of the same round in a ground-carried frame and draws the arc and impact ring
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via StepOnce: store steering and sight solve; then the sight draw)
harmony-prefix KSA.SunbloomRenderer.Render (impact ring painted by the ring pass)

title: Gunner's sight painted over a borrowed view or a camera window
description: The gunner's sight is drawn with ImGui draw-list strokes over whichever view a director drives, picking the background, platform-viewport foreground or window list per surface, projecting through that view's camera and zooming by magnification
hooks: subclass-override KSA.FixedController.OnFrame (field of view set from the pose source)

title: What a high or airless burst lights in the sky, chosen by the air at the burst
description: The air density at a nuclear burst picks which sky effects it starts, each drawn as an analytic full-screen compute dispatch tagged by a negative bound in the cloud pass, and an airless body gets one-shot KSA particle emitters instead

title: Holed tanks that drain through the engine's mole states and throw a painted stream
description: A shell hole under a tank's liquid level drains it at an orifice rate through Mole.ConsumeStored in a Vehicle.PrepareWorker prefix, with the bookkeeping KSA's DepleteConsumables does, and big leaks throw a stream painted before bloom

title: Per-triangle hull hit test with the engine's part ray cast
description: A shell's step is tested against the target craft's real part meshes with KSA's own watertight Part.RayCastEgo, cast in a metres-scale frame centred on the round, after a bounding-sphere broad phase

title: A ballistic computer that flies any player-built rocket to a latitude and longitude
description: A per-craft computer samples the vehicle in the parent body's inertial frame, solves universal-variable Lambert over flight time against a spinning-planet target, steers by velocity-to-be-gained, times cutoff to the frame boundary and checks itself against a flown impact prediction

title: IFF teams, alliances and the per-frame team roster
description: KSA has no sides, so the mod keeps its own team names, puts a craft on a team through the flag on its panel row, rebuilds a reference-keyed craft-to-team roster every simulated step, and classifies every contact as friendly, hostile, neutral or unknown against per-team rules of engagement

title: File bug reports from an ImGui form through a guarded issue service
description: An ImGui report window posts a summary, details and the tail of the mod's own log to a small self-hosted service that files a GitHub issue, sending from a background task only when the player clicks Send and only when the running KSA build matches the one the mod was built for

title: JIT-compile the mod and the engine's destroy path on a background thread at load
description: At StarMapAllModsLoaded a Task.Run walks every method of the mod assembly and six engine types and calls RuntimeHelpers.PrepareMethod, so the first kill of a session no longer pays tens of milliseconds of JIT in one frame

title: Pin the KSA build with a hashed assemblies lock file
description: A committed lock file of SHA-256 digests per referenced game DLL keeps local builds, CI's private assemblies mirror and the running game on one KSA build, and stamps that build into the mod for a runtime comparison

title: Set off KSA's own explosion at an arbitrary point, anchored on the planet
description: A burst in mid-air with no vehicle to host it calls ExplosionSystem.SpawnPreset with a BubbleOrigin fixed in the body's rotating frame, real ambient pressure for the pressure-gated stages, and a preset chosen by fireball size because KSA floors explosion intensity

title: Separate a launcher from its stack by firing the decoupler on its own joint
description: Find the Decoupler module on the one connection holding a part on, ask whether the player's next stage would fire it, and fire it directly with Decoupler.SetIsActive so the split goes through KSA's input buffer on the next frame

title: A MIRV post-boost bus that trims with RCS, re-points between releases and lets its warheads go
description: After cutoff the bus nulls its velocity error against the propagated burnout solution one translation axis at a time in pulse mode, waits out the split, re-points so each tube lies on the release line, releases on a cost-of-holding rule, then goes quiet so KSA can put it back on rails

title: Mod-simulated rounds integrated in sub-steps inside the frame
description: Missiles, shells and bombs are not KSA vehicles but plain C# objects the mod integrates itself, in fixed sub-steps across each applied simulation step, from the same pass that draws them

title: Operator panel in ImGui with a menu-bar entry and ModMenu registration
description: A multi-window Dear ImGui operator panel (craft switcher with drawn icon buttons, tabbed per-craft window, weapons switcher, pop-out panes, reopen button) drawn from the after-GUI hook, plus a menu from the before-GUI hook and a copied attribute that lets ModMenu list the mod

title: Optical director heads with mast and roll-nod gimbals
description: Optical directors are inert parts whose head and pod roll collar are subparts slewed by a rate-limited drive, clamped to a mast elevation band or a roll-nod annulus with a keyhole, and resolved into an eye, sight line and roll for camera and laser

title: Own log file, build stamps and a developer marker file
description: A batched, thread-safe log written to KSArmory.log beside KSA's logs with the previous session kept as KSArmory.prev.log, a version and KSA-build stamp read from assembly metadata, and developer tools switched on by an empty file named developer next to the DLL

title: Per-craft settings as a JSON sidecar inside the save folder
description: Each weapon system's switches are flattened into a versioned-by-defaults DTO and kept in saves/<save>/KSArmory/systems.json keyed by craft name, read when a system is crewed and written only when universe.xml's timestamp shows the game saved

title: Launcher parts get lighter as their stores leave
description: Each frame the mod works out how much a launcher or dispenser part has shed in fired rounds, then rescales that part's inert mass through KSA's per-part InertMass slot and recomputes the craft's mass properties inside a Harmony prefix on Vehicle.PrepareWorker, before the physics worker copies them

title: Point gravity, body fall and one-reference air for mod-integrated bodies
description: Rounds the mod integrates itself feel mu over r squared toward their body back-dated to the sub-step, plus the body's own fall toward its primary, and are dragged by air and water read from KSA's atmosphere and ocean against one fixed reference density, avoiding KSA's IsValid traps

title: Mod-authored particle emitters taken from KSA's shared pool and re-anchored each frame
description: Plumes, muzzle flashes, flares, chaff, flak smoke and blast dust are the mod's own ParticleEmitter assets taken by Id from the engine's fixed pool, anchored to a celestial's rotating frame, re-pointed each frame while following, and always Kill()ed before return

title: Command vehicles from a Vehicle.PrepareWorker prefix
description: Every write KSArmory makes to another craft (attitude, pulse mode, throttle, staging, blast impulse, tanks, store mass) is queued and performed in a Harmony prefix on Vehicle.PrepareWorker, the only point where it survives KSA's double-buffered vehicle state

title: True proportional navigation for mod-flown missiles
description: Guided rounds steer by true proportional navigation on a back-dated target sample, with gravity biased out, the command projected square to the airflow and clipped to an airframe g limit, and boost or sustain stages pushing along the velocity gained since release

title: Radar PPI scope and shaded-relief terrain map drawn with ImGui primitives
description: A craft-centred polar radar scope and a 64x64 hill-shaded relief map are drawn only with window draw-list primitives in a north-up frame from the body's rotation axis, the heights resampled from the engine's height field only on movement, span change or every ten seconds

title: Radar search cone, masking and lock dwell
description: A per-weapon radar rebuilt every simulated step from a once-per-pass vehicle census plus the mod's own rounds, filtered by range, cone, Doppler, clutter, planet, terrain, chaff and fireball, and held to a dwell time before a track becomes a firing solution

title: A raymarched mushroom cloud, held body-fixed and drawn before bloom
description: Each nuclear cloud is held in its planet's rotating frame and aged on simulated time, its Glasstone-sized shape packed into a 128-byte push constant, then raymarched per pixel into a layer that a temporal resolve blends into the scene before bloom

title: One check script shared by the pre-push hook and CI
description: One check-all script runs about twenty textual and offline checks (Sim/ boundary, network egress, planet-agnostic code, XML, settings reachability, shaders, documented numbers, tracked artefacts) from a git pre-push hook and from CI, skipping game-dependent ones with a notice

title: Round bodies drawn past the engine's pixel cull and as part-model instances
description: A postfix on Vehicle.UpdateRenderData redraws a sub-pixel launcher while its rounds fly, and a prefix on PartModelRenderer.UpdateRenderData adds gun shells and the rounds of a destroyed launcher as extra instances of the engine's own part meshes, per viewport

title: Rounds drawn as hidden launcher subparts flown by transform writes
description: Each tube's missile is a pre-declared subpart of the launcher, seated in its tube or shrunk to a millimetre while unfired, then placed every rendered frame at the mod-simulated round's position and carried attitude by writing its parent-relative transform

title: Destroy vehicles and break off parts safely from a frame hook
description: Kills are batched behind one JobSystems.VehicleSolver.Wait barrier, part losses are queued into the vehicle's private update state as a PartFailureEvent that the engine applies with its own crash damage, disposal uses DestroyVehicle under a shapes lock, and debris is recognised by KSA's split naming

title: Seekers, command uplink and laser designation
description: Guided rounds are broken by what they can see, so the mod models a seeker gimbal, decoy seduction judged once per decoy, a command uplink that dies with the launcher's track, anti-radiation homing with emission memory, and laser spots cast on meshes and terrain (not yet homed on)

title: Gun travel limits swept from the craft's own geometry with part ray casts
description: Each gun mount's traverse arc and per-bearing elevation band are discovered by ray-casting its barrel and line of fire against the other parts of its craft, on a budget of 50 rays and 1 ms a frame once the craft has held its shape for 60 frames

title: TV and thermal look for a camera window, recorded before bloom
description: A two-dispatch compute pass recorded from the SunbloomRenderer.Render prefix turns one secondary viewport's HDR scene into a TV or white-hot/black-hot picture mapped around its log-mean brightness, measured first into a 1x1 image, so bloom and the tonemap expose it normally

title: The blast front drawn as a bend in the light, by copying the scene and writing it back at an offset
description: Each nuclear blast front is drawn as a refracting shell, not an object, by two compute dispatches before bloom that copy KSA's HDR scene image and write each pixel back from the copy, displaced where the view ray grazes the front's sphere

title: Compare mod variants in flight with interleaved batches and rank statistics
description: A batch harness flies unattended ballistic shots of every prebuilt variant in seeded interleaved order with the deployed DLL hashed per shot, and a report judges arms with an exact Wilcoxon rank-sum test, Hodges-Lehmann effects, a stopping rule and within-run splits

title: Headless tests enforced by a game-free Sim/ source boundary
description: All simulation code lives in a folder that may not reference KSA types, and the xUnit project links that folder wholesale against only the numerics assemblies, so the boundary enforces itself and whole engagements are flown with no game present

title: Spatialised gun and rocket-motor sounds driven by held FMOD channels
description: Gun fire is an XML CompoundSound (spin-up, loop, tail) played once per firing system and moved every frame, a slow gun gets one pitched gunshot per round, and each burning mod-simulated rocket gets Core's engine loop with its Throttle parameter pinned open

title: Spawn test drones and teleport craft from the panel, a click or a script
description: Test drones are built from a stock or library craft save on an orbit solved backwards from the requested pass, created under the engine's shapes-registry lock and added to the parent body's children, while craft are moved by queuing the engine's own TeleportToLocation
hooks: harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnFrameCelestials (UpdateWorldClicks via StepOnce, HUD hidden)
starmap StarMapAfterOnFrame (bridge spawn and site commands)

title: StarMap entry class with per-hook fault containment
description: One [StarMapMod] class binds six StarMap hooks, wraps every frame hook in its own try/catch and switches the whole mod off after ten faults instead of letting an exception escape into KSA's frame loop

title: Repair saves at startup after removing a part's subparts
description: Before any save can be loaded, the mod rewrites every save and library craft that lists more subparts for one of its parts than the part now declares, because KSA pairs saved subparts with the definition by position and a surplus kills the process on load

title: Terrain ground-impact test against the engine's height field
description: Rounds, sights and cursor rays find the ground through Celestial.GetTerrainHeightFromDirCce(accurate true) clamped to the sea, answered as a centre and a surface radius so a round can test its height at every sub-step for the cost of a subtraction

title: Hold timewarp down while rounds or burns are in flight
description: A closed-loop policy that reads the step KSA applied, writes Universe.SetSimulationSpeed down to the speed whose step a round can integrate, waits out the two-frame actuator delay, yields to the player or auto-warp, and gives the speed back when the air is clear

title: Motor and flare smoke through KSA's volumetric booster-trail renderer
description: Burning rounds and flares lay billowing body-fixed smoke by submitting one PlumeTrailEmitterState cursor each per frame to the engine's own VolumetricTrailRenderer, reached through one reflected private field, with each segment thrown back along the trail so it swells

title: Fly scripted scenarios unattended and report a pass or fail verdict
description: A developer-only state machine reads a request file beside the mod log at load, loads a save, spawns targets, flies an engagement, bomb drop, gunnery run or ballistic shot, and writes tagged SCENARIO lines that a shell harness waits on, screenshots and turns into an exit code

title: Ballistic lead for unguided shells, from a fixed-point solve to flying the shell
description: A gun is laid by iterating time of flight to a tolerance against the target's relative motion and acceleration, then refined by flying simulated shells through drag, gravity and a turning ground with a Broyden-updated aim correction, with a halving search for targets beyond reach

title: Asset-only weapon packs read from a KSArmory folder in every installed mod
description: At StarMapAllModsLoaded KSArmory walks KSA's mod manifest, reads every XML file in a KSArmory/ folder inside each mod (its own included), and registers weapon definitions through a strict, culture-invariant reader that refuses unknown attributes by name

title: Weapon parts as inert KSA parts split into an Assets file and a GameData file
description: Each weapon is a plain KSA part declared in two mod.toml-listed XML bundles (art and subparts in KSArmoryAssets.xml, mass, colliders, connectors, editor tags and real RCS thrusters in KSArmoryGameData.xml), with no behaviour in XML because the C# finds the part by Id

title: A weapon system is data plus art, discovered by part Id
description: Launchers, rounds, sensors, optics and craft components are plain profile objects in a registry that is open until all mods load and then frozen, and the mod crews one weapon system per matching launcher part it finds on any craft, following that part across splits and docks

title: World-anchored screen markers on full-screen ImGui overlay windows
description: Brackets, lock cues, chase brackets and part-health bars are projected through the viewport camera's EclToScreen/EgoToScreen onto transparent, input-less, full-screen ImGui windows, with off-screen targets clamped to the screen edge from the camera basis, not the projection

title: KSArmory
description: Weapon systems for Kitten Space Agency built as reusable machinery (sensors, fire control, sub-frame projectiles, articulated mounts, a ballistic computer, compute-shader effects) with each weapon a registry entry plus art, bound to the game by six StarMap hooks and six Harmony patches

title: Asset XML, mesh and shader checks that run without the game
description: Python and shell checks that catch silent asset failures before launch, including undeclared or colliding ids, missing or case-wrong paths, shared texture files, C# names with no asset, z-fighting and degenerate UVs in GLB meshes, and GLSL that will not compile

title: Fly the nearest craft from the office computer
description: Seated in the office chair, Enter hands the player's controls to the nearest craft by swapping Program.ControlledVehicle while the main view stays at the kitten's eyes and a borrowed secondary viewport films the craft for the monitor

title: Core shader library include
description: A header written at StarMapImmediateLoad holds absolute include paths into the player's install, so a mod's Shader asset can include KSA's Global.glsl, AtmosphereLuts.glsl and TextureSet.glsl

title: Developer file bridge and MCP server for driving a running game
description: On a developer install the mod polls a folder for JSON commands (load, step, camera, lighting, shader reload, screenshot capture with manifests) and a stdlib Python MCP server turns that folder into tools an agent can call

title: Dry volume below sea level
description: A radial column under the office is kept free of KSA's planet-wide ocean, by zeroing the ocean values physics sees inside it and skipping the ocean surface, underwater fog and ocean depth occlusion while the camera is inside

title: First-person body hiding with a full-body shadow
description: An IAnimProcessor folds every bone of the walking kitten to its head for the main view only, and Draw postfixes swap the folded kitten's shadow entries for a second skinning of the whole body, so the kitten is invisible to its own eyes but still casts its full shadow

title: First-person view for a kitten on foot
description: V puts the main view at the flown kitten's eyes using a head-bone pose processor and a borrowed Fixed camera mode, right-drag looks around, and a worker-thread patch on KittenLocomotion.StepGrounded turns the walk to follow the look

title: One step per frame across three hooks, on the simulation clock
description: Runs the mod's per-frame step from whichever of the GUI postfix, a prefix on Program.OnFrameCelestials or the frame postfix reaches it first, integrates the engine's own applied sim step exactly once, and notices save loads through a Program.OnGameLoaded postfix

title: Garage spot lights submitted per viewport
description: Ceiling lamps made of KSA's own spot lights, resubmitted every frame for every viewport from the static-object render-data postfix, with the nearest lamps flagged to fill the player's light-shadow slots

title: A generated spiral ramp - mesh, shadow caster, box colliders and lamps from one script
description: Generates the deep spiral ramp and hall from a numpy and Pillow script that writes the GLB atlas, an invisible shadow-caster GLB, flat-colour textures, the static sub-objects and stepped box colliders spliced into the asset XML between markers, and the lamp table as C#

title: Ground clutter kept off the launch pads nearest the camera
description: A postfix on the private GroundClutterPlacementData.PopulateLaunchPadExclusionZones replaces the engine's first-four-pads-in-list-order clutter exclusion with the four launch pads nearest the main camera, so a mod-added pad gets its grass and trees cleared

title: Headless tests over a KSA-free Sim folder, assembly resolution and CI
description: Splits the code into a Sim folder with no KSA types that a test project links wholesale, resolves the game's assemblies from several places with a digest lock, and runs one check script from both the pre-push hook and CI, which builds against a private assemblies repository

title: Invisible shadow casters
description: Caster meshes that are never drawn are built as engine StaticMeshRenderables and pushed into the SuperMesh shadow pool each frame, so the sun and the lamps are blocked by a building whose static object casts no shadow

title: A replacement fixed camera controller with an up vector and an in-phase pose
description: Subclasses KSA's FixedController, installs it into the main viewport through the auto-property backing field, and has it ask the mod for the camera pose and roll inside the engine's own viewport pass, with right-drag look and smooth roll

title: A lift built from a moving launch-pad landmark
description: Runs a passenger lift by rewriting a second launch-pad landmark's GroundOffset every simulated step, carrying and waking riders from a PrepareWorker prefix, and reading the floor keys through ImGui

title: Terrain slope displacement held down live in the planet renderer's material buffer
description: While the camera is near the site, reflects into PlanetRenderer's persistently mapped biome-material buffer and clamps the Grass and Beach slope materials' displacementScale to their ground materials', restoring the stored values when the camera leaves

title: Per-mod log file beside KSA's logs
description: Writes the mod's own batched log to Logs/KSAStructures.log under the KSA user folder, keeps the previous session's log, flushes on a timer thread and immediately on warnings, and switches to debug detail at runtime

title: Office furniture as single-part craft, kept out of saves
description: Sets an office chair with an IVA seat and an EVA door, and a monitor, down in the building as one-part craft built in code, and strips them from every save so a save never depends on the mod

title: Launch-pad landmarks that stand a walkable building on Earth
description: Stands a multi-part static object at a fixed latitude and longitude on Earth by adding IsLaunchPad landmarks to the Earth template at load, then draws it itself whenever the engine culls it

title: Noticing a save load with a Program.OnGameLoaded postfix
description: A Harmony postfix on Program.OnGameLoaded latches a flag that the mod's next frame step consumes to drop state from the replaced world, because StarMap has no load hook and the flight scene never ends across a load

title: Settings menu entry, settings window and optional ModMenu listing
description: Adds a KSA Structures menu from the StarMapBeforeGui hook, a small settings window from StarMapAfterGui, and lists itself in ModMenu through a copied attribute without depending on it

title: Terrain decal pits dug at load
description: Levels and digs Earth's terrain under the office by deserializing DecalModifierReference XML in code and inserting it into both of the Earth template's modifier lists at StarMapAllModsLoaded, before the terrain-modifier render data and the planet renderer's buffers are sized from the modifier count

title: Terrain height answered as roof, ramp or floor
description: Postfixes the camera-frame terrain height query so wheels, cameras and placement see the garage roof, the ramp slabs or the pit floor depending on who is asking, while Bepu terrain collision keeps the real pit

title: Underground dark compute pass
description: A first-priority Harmony prefix on SunbloomRenderer.Render dispatches a mod compute shader over the main view's HDR scene image, scaling the sky's ambient out of every pixel inside the dug rooms before bloom and tonemapping

title: Live viewport image on an in-world monitor
description: A secondary camera viewport's finished image is shown on a monitor part by repointing the part material's bindless diffuse and emissive slots at it, with an ImGui background-draw-list quad grid painted over the screen for full brightness

title: KSAStructures
description: A StarMap code mod that stands a walkable office tower on Earth as launch-pad static objects dug into the terrain at load, with a lift, an underground garage lit by shadow-casting lamps, a spiral ramp, a chair and computer that fly the nearest craft, and a first-person kitten view

title: Dummy companion body
description: A locally defined atmospheric body with tiny height data is loaded beside three stock-planet presets

title: Planet starting situations
description: Custom Situation assets place the stock Gemini7 vessel in a chosen orbit around each planet

title: Single-planet system presets
description: Three native System XML files select Sol and one stock planet as a smaller playable system

title: Lonely Planets
description: Native XML systems select one planet around Sol with a custom starter vessel and situation

title: Generated mod.toml and CI release pipeline
description: MSBuild items generate mod.toml with the assets array and StarMap ModDependencies on every build, and a GitHub Actions workflow builds against KSA DLLs from a private repo via a GitHub App token, then publishes GitHub and SpaceDock releases

title: Color grading shader math
description: Reusable grading formulas from MPFX's shaders: lift, gamma and gain in a mat4 with an on/off flag, a 1000 to 40000 K temperature tint with luminance preservation, YIQ hue rotation, mid-gray HDR contrast, Rec. 709 saturation, overlay and an aspect-corrected vignette

title: Uniform buffer and push constant structs bound by attribute name
description: MPFX tags blittable structs with private copies of ShaderExtensions' SxUniformBuffer and SxPushConstant attributes, and ShaderExtensions finds them by name, registers XML elements and fills their static lookup delegates, so MPFX never references ShaderExtensions.dll
hooks: reflection static delegate fields filled by ShaderExtensions

title: Effect chain declared as RenderPassId-ordered post-process assets
description: MPFX declares its whole effect stack in one XML asset file as 16 PostProcessingShader (pre-ImGui) and 16 GlobalPostShader (post-ImGui) elements with RenderPassId 128 to 143, sharing parameter buffers between the two sides by Id

title: Effect settings window and ModMenu entry
description: One ImGui window with button-driven tabs, a three-column table of collapsing headers per effect with pre/post ImGui rows, a reusable slider-plus-input row helper, color pickers and per-row Reset buttons, opened from a ModMenu attribute entry

title: Shader contract for chain passes
description: Each MPFX fragment shader follows the ShaderExtensions pass contract, with the previous pass as sampler2D at set 1 binding 0, ShaderTime at binding 1, one parameter block at binding 2 and an optional push constant, and returns its input when parameters are neutral

title: Film grain and experimental effects
description: Animated film grain driven by a per-side push-constant clock that can follow time warp, built on Ashima/Gustavson GLSL noise with soft-light blending and luminance falloff, plus the self-described experimental RGB2HSV, HSV2RGB and SingleColor passes kept under a Fun stuff header

title: Per-frame effect parameter upload
description: From StarMapAfterGui, MPFX writes film grain time into push constants every frame the HUD is shown and rewrites every effect uniform buffer through ShaderExtensions span lookups only when a dirty flag set by the settings window is raised, substituting neutral values for disabled effects

title: Separable Gaussian blur with CPU-computed weights
description: A two-pass horizontal and vertical Gaussian blur where C# computes normalized one-sided weights for a radius up to 20 and packs them into a std140 int-plus-vec4[6] uniform block, one shader file serving both chains through different buffer Ids

title: Effect profiles as XML assets with clipboard export
description: MPFXProfile is a KittenExtensions KxAsset type, so profiles load from any mod's asset XML, while profiles created in game live only in memory and the Export tab serializes the current one with XmlSerializer, DefaultValue and ShouldSerialize trimming, for the user to paste into an asset file by hand

title: MPFX
description: Small post-processing mod by AMPW that declares a 32-pass color-grading chain as ShaderExtensions XML assets, feeds it from an ImGui settings window each frame and keeps profiles only as hand-copied XML

title: Attitude-mode hand-off patches
