description: Detect every stock path that changes attitude mode with Harmony prefixes on flight computer, vehicle, kitten and MMU methods so a mod-owned custom target is released and the shared rate command restored

title: Game-styled popups and toasts
description: Show KSA-styled modal confirmations by subclassing the game's Popup class, which self-registers for Popup.DrawAll, and give feedback with TimedAlert toasts

title: AT-HYG star catalog and star information
description: Parse the 330k-row AT-HYG CSV into Hipparcos-keyed ecliptic directions and star records, special-case the central star, and browse stars by constellation, proper name or Bayer designation in an ImGui tab

title: settings.ini persistence
description: Persist every overlay and window option as key=value lines in a settings.ini beside the DLL, saving on each change and every frame the window open state differs, while ImGui keeps window geometry

title: Mod root and packaging
description: Resolve the mod folder from the running assembly location, ship data beside the DLL with an overridable game path and an explicit deploy target, and rely on StarMap default entry-assembly resolution

title: ModMenu entry and game-styled windows
description: Register an Oh My Stars submenu through the ModMenuEntry attribute and draw resizable windows with the game ConsoleStyle and ConsoleWidgets look while keeping ImGui saved geometry

title: Navball star marker
description: Reproduce NavBallRenderer.ToScreenMarker and the NavballMarkers.glsl styling in C# to paint a custom star marker, rim arrow and label on the stock navball through the ImGui foreground draw list

title: Orient a vessel to a star
description: Point a vessel or kitten at a star by writing a Custom EclBody attitude target to the stock flight computer and re-applying it in a Vehicle.PrepareWorker prefix just before the physics snapshot

title: Occlusion by bodies
description: Hide sky-overlay points behind planets, moons, the star and vehicles with a per-frame CPU ray-sphere test against every body and body-orbiting vehicle of the camera's current system

title: RA/Dec grid
description: Draw a celestial right ascension and declination grid as 1-degree arcs with a clip-space near-frustum cull and overlap-free chart labels on the same star sphere as the constellations

title: Save-scoped settings sidecar
description: Postfix UncompressedSave.Load and Make to track the current save and write an atomic per-save settings file into the save folder (vestigial in this version)

title: Constellation lines and labels on the sky
description: Convert J2000 RA/Dec to the game ecliptic frame, place points on the camera-centred 19.5-unit star sphere, project with Camera.EgoToScreen and draw lines and labels into a transparent full-screen ImGui window from StarMapAfterGui

title: Star binary switcher
description: Discover star binary files, rewrite Mod.StarBinaries by reflection and reload the instanced star field at runtime with capacity-aware sampling, named presets and game-styled confirmation popups

title: Star instance restyle patch
description: Restyle every background star by prefixing InstancedStarTechnique.AddInstance to rewrite its size and colour bytes, and resize the instance buffer at runtime by reflecting into the technique

title: Star pointer
description: Draw a line from the mod window to the selected star, pushing off-screen and behind-camera targets to the screen edge through the clip-space direction

title: Stellarium sky cultures
description: Load 53 legacy Stellarium sky cultures from constellationship.fab and constellation_names files, switch between them at runtime, and keep only segments whose stars match the stock star binary bit for bit

title: Oh My Stars
description: StarMap mod that draws constellation lines, names, IAU boundaries and an RA/Dec grid on the sky from Stellarium and AT-HYG data, with a star browser, navball marker, orient-to-star mode and a star field editor

title: Anchoring a world-space quad to a part or to the camera
description: Place a quad in KSA's camera-relative ego space from a vehicle part's position and rotation plus a user offset, follow the same Part object through decoupling and docking, or pin it in view space in front of the camera as a billboard

title: Logging through a Brutal LogCategory in a shared assembly
description: Give the mod one Brutal.Logging LogCategory in a tiny assembly so every project, and other mods that import it, log into KSA's console, stdout and monitor with interpolated-string handlers and caller info

title: Click-through lock mode with a refocus hot zone
description: Make an unfocused ImGui window ignore the mouse so clicks reach the game, and give it a tiny separate hot-zone window that refocuses it, with focus visuals drawn on the foreground draw list

title: Hosting Windows shells in a ConPTY from inside the game
description: Spawn PowerShell, cmd or WSL attached to a Windows pseudoconsole from the KSA process, with null std handles, a never-sleeping pipe pump, a queued writer thread and a flush-then-close teardown that never closes a handle another thread is blocked on

title: One-zip cross-platform build, deploy and release pipeline
description: Resolve KSA reference assemblies from an env var or a sibling checkout with a fail-fast check, wipe-and-copy an allow-listed payload plus all native libraries into the mod folder on every build, and test on three OSes before stamping and publishing a release zip

title: Inter-mod shell contract shared through StarMap assembly imports
description: Ship a small contract assembly that other mods resolve from purrTTY's AssemblyLoadContext by listing it in their mod.toml ImportedAssemblies, so both mods share one CustomShellRegistry.Instance, with a vendored fallback when purrTTY is absent

title: Custom shell registry, lifecycle and PTY bridge
description: An ICustomShell interface with a validated, reflection-discovered registry and line-buffered base classes, adapted to the PTY process-manager interface so in-process shells (game console, SSH into a VM) behave exactly like real shells in the terminal

title: Injecting world-space draws after KSA's translucency pass
description: A Harmony postfix on SuperMeshRenderSystem.RenderTranslucencyPass that issues tracked image barriers and opens its own dynamic-rendering scope over the scene's color and depth attachments, so custom translucent geometry draws after atmosphere, clouds and ocean have repainted the frame

title: Failure-isolated Harmony patching with reload-safe statics
description: Apply each Harmony patch class on its own with CreateClassProcessor inside a try/catch and classify patches as required or optional so a drifted game target never takes the mod down, plus a defensive lazy Harmony instance and static-state reset on unload

title: The KSA game console as a terminal shell
description: A custom shell that runs typed lines through KSA's TerminalInterface and captures the console's colored output with a Harmony postfix on ConsoleWindow.Print, gated so only output produced during the command is captured

title: Game menu with a ModMenu entry and a DrawProgramMenusHook fallback
description: Draw the same mod menu through the ModMenu companion's attribute when it is installed, otherwise through a Harmony postfix on KSA's empty Program.DrawProgramMenusHook, keeping the draw path allocation-free and detection-free

title: Gate game input while a terminal is focused
description: Harmony prefixes on Program.OnKey, GameSettings.OnKeyAll and the private Program.DispatchKeyEvent keep KSA hotkeys and mouse bindings from firing while the player types into a terminal, without stranding held keys

title: Headless terminal surface with a renderer-neutral frame snapshot
description: A backend that owns the native VT engine on one thread, accepts PTY bytes from any thread into a bounded inbox, and produces a dirty-aware TerminalFrame of pre-resolved cells that any frontend (ImGui window or world texture) can draw

title: Headless test suites for a KSA mod
description: Four NUnit projects that test a game mod without the game, against the real KSA reference assemblies where cheap, with property tests, real-PTY OS-gated tests, and enforced rules that tests are silent on success and never use fixed sleeps

title: Filterable combo and form-table widgets for Brutal ImGui
description: A combo box with a live substring filter that works around ImInputString only refreshing its length on a true InputText return, plus label-gutter form tables and a destructive button

title: ImGui keyboard and mouse to terminal input
description: Turn ImGui key presses, the character queue, clipboard chords and mouse gestures into VT byte sequences via the engine encoders, with selection, app mouse reporting and AltGr handling

title: Kitty graphics images as ImGui Vulkan textures
description: Upload images decoded from the kitty graphics protocol into SimpleVkTexture objects, register them with KSA's ImGui Vulkan backend as ImTextureRef, and draw them in grid-aligned z-bands with an LRU cache under the shared descriptor pool

title: KSA upgrade coupling review skill
description: An AI-assistant skill that drives a diff of two decompiled KSA builds against a catalog of every place the mod couples to game code, classified by how each coupling fails (compile, patch load, reflection, silent behavior)

title: Named terminal registry and per-target theme dialog
description: Address every terminal, 2D ImGui window or in-world texture, by a unique case-insensitive name through one INamedTerminal registry, and drive a non-modal dialog that applies whole appearance bundles to the selected target

title: Bundled Nerd Fonts loaded into the ImGui atlas
description: Ship monospace Nerd Fonts with a renamed extension so KSA does not auto-load them, add them to the shared ImGui atlas at mod init, and size them per draw with PushFont

title: Render-to-texture with a second ImGui context and Vulkan backend
description: Draw ImGui UI into a mod-owned off-screen Vulkan image by creating a secondary ImGui context that shares the game's font atlas, a second instance of KSA's ImGuiBackendVulkanImpl bound to a mod render pass, and a mod-owned command pool, ring of fences and queue submit

title: OSC 52 clipboard writes into the game clipboard
description: Tee the PTY byte stream through a small managed OSC scanner so remote and local programs can set the system clipboard via OSC 52, applied with ImGui.SetClipboardText on the main thread

title: Per-platform native library resolver for a mod's AssemblyLoadContext
description: A ModuleInitializer installs NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver so P/Invoke finds the right per-OS shared library beside the mod DLL inside StarMap's mod AssemblyLoadContext, plus a libc resolver for glibc and macOS

title: POSIX pty shells spawned without fork
description: Allocate a pty with posix_openpt and launch the shell with posix_spawnp (SETSID, slave opened as stdin, signal state reset) so a multi-gigabyte, heavily threaded game process never forks, with the arm64 variadic ioctl fix and a poll-based reader

title: Handing PTY threads' output to the game frame
description: The thread map that lets blocking PTY readers, writers and slow shell spawns feed a single-threaded engine that is only touched from the KSA main thread inside StarMapAfterGui, with bounded queues in both directions and synchronous close on the tick thread

title: Click-to-focus and input routing for world-space panels
description: Pick the nearest world-space quad under the mouse with Cursor.GetEgoRay and Moller-Trumbore triangle tests, convert the hit to texture UV and terminal cells, and route keyboard and app-mouse input to that panel's shell while gating game input

title: Rebindable toggle hotkey with a capture modal
description: A configurable key-plus-modifiers hotkey read from ImGui IO each frame, with a press-to-capture modal, text-field suppression and first-frame swallowing when it opens the terminal

title: Saved terminal layouts with startup commands
description: Save and restore named sets of 2D and in-world terminals as hand-emitted TOML, applied only on user request with name-collision skips, per-terminal startup commands typed into the shell, and an MRU command history

title: Shell detection and launch command resolution
description: Detect installed shells, WSL distributions and /etc/shells entries once on a background thread with bounded waits, define availability as resolvability, and build Windows command lines with CommandLineToArgvW quoting versus discrete argv on Unix

title: Terminal grid drawn with ImGui draw lists
description: Paint a full terminal cell grid (backgrounds, glyph runs, block and braille glyphs, decorations, cursor) into an ImGui window draw list every frame with run batching

title: Multi-window terminals with tabs, hidden chrome and grid snap
description: Run several title-bar-less ImGui terminal windows with tab bars, chrome that fades without changing layout, an invisible grid button that stops drag-moves, and a resize that snaps to whole cells

title: TOML settings and alacritty-format themes
description: Persist mod settings with Tomlyn under the KSA Documents folder, load bundled and user color schemes in alacritty TOML format, and write every file atomically with temp-then-rename

title: Vendored libghostty-vt binding as the terminal engine
description: Delegate all VT emulation to Ghostty's standalone libghostty-vt through a vendored, pruned and patched .NET binding with source-generated P/Invoke, a managed packed-cell decoder and a startup layout self-check

title: Safe Vulkan teardown and live resize for mod-owned GPU resources
description: Stop recording a resource immediately, free it only after the frames that may reference it have completed plus a device WaitIdle, rebuild render targets in place for live resizes, and never touch the Vulkan device in StarMapUnload because the game has already destroyed it

title: World-space textured quad pipeline with a runtime-compiled shader
description: Build a dynamic-rendering Vulkan pipeline that draws a textured quad into KSA's scene target, reusing the game's UnlitMeshVert vertex shader, compiling a premultiplied-alpha fragment shader at runtime with the bundled shaderc, depth-testing against reverse-Z without writing depth

title: purrTTY
description: In-game terminal emulator for KSA that hosts real shells (ConPTY, POSIX pty, in-game console, other mods' shells) on libghostty-vt and renders them as ImGui windows or as textures on world-space quads

title: Per-body atmosphere optics in the system XML
description: Rewrites Rayleigh, Mie and ozone values for ten bodies from generated physics, promotes Pluto and Triton to AtmosphericBody, and repurposes the ozone slot and scale heights as absorbers and shader keys

title: Atmosphere uniform side channel
description: Prefix and postfix around AtmosphereRenderer.FillPlanetAtmosphereData put the sim clock, a feature switch and a spin axis into unused fields of the stock atmosphere uniform data, and invalidate kept LUTs

title: Cloud face lighting
description: Lights an optically thick volumetric cloud step where its first optical depth ends, found by bisection, and adds a short self-shadow march, so dense decks keep their brightness from any distance

title: Cloud layers in the system XML
description: Inserts templated volumetric cloud decks with masks and flowmaps for the giants, rebuilds Venus's and Jupiter's decks, adds Mars cirrus and Titan hazes, and derives each layer's light-march distance from its geometry

title: Cloud pass shading and ring shadows
description: Shader patches to the 2D cloud pass (terminator fade, map-coloured skylight, opaque Venus shell, thin Triton shell), a column-limited thin-cloud ground shadow, and ring shadows added to both cloud passes

title: Core XML entry redirect
description: Harmony prefixes on four KSA.Mod loader methods swap the Core mod's Astronomicals.xml and Sol template entries for absolute paths to patched copies, so the game's own loaders read the copies

title: Shared shadow for two cooperating mods
description: Two sibling mods that edit the same Core XML files write into one shared copy, serialized by a global named mutex and reset to stock exactly once per game process by a launch token

title: Haze-band sky march
description: Drifting haze bands for Titan, Pluto and Triton, baked into the LUT density as shells for thin hazes and added to sky pixels by a per-pixel raymarch blended in only where a band could be visible

title: Measured-atmosphere code generator
description: Offline Python that builds measured density and pressure profiles for ten bodies, applies KSA's boundary thresholds and emits one C# file of flight tables, XML values and GLSL tables, plus a numpy renderer port

title: Measured density tables in the atmosphere shaders
description: Rewrites the six exponential density evaluations in KSA's atmosphere shaders to one injected function that reads generated per-body ln-density tables keyed by radius and scale height

title: Measured flight atmospheres
description: Prefixes on PhysicalAtmosphereReference's density and pressure functions return measured profiles for ten bodies, attached per atmosphere in a ConditionalWeakTable at load, with the boundary height moved to match

title: Mie phase sentinel dispatch
description: Replaces MiePhaseFunction with a dispatcher that treats out-of-range XML asymmetry values as flags, selecting a Mie-theory Mars dust phase (fit or GLSL LUT) or a two-part Pluto haze phase without new uniforms

title: ModMenu page and TOML settings
description: A ModMenu page found through a vendored attribute, drawn with ImGui calls emitted as DynamicMethods because ImString is a ref struct, and persisted to a hand-parsed settings.toml

title: Nearby-body choice transpiler
description: A Harmony transpiler rewrites the comparison in CelestialSystem.GetNearbyAstronomical so a body within 25 of its radii ranks first, stopping a passing small moon from stealing its planet's detailed render

title: Reflection-only mod build
description: Compiles against StarMap.API and 0Harmony only, reaches every game member by name through AccessTools, checks each target's shape before patching, and degrades one subsystem at a time when the game changes

title: Release packaging and deploy scripts
description: Two PowerShell scripts sharing one asset list build the mod and either install it into the active game instance or package a release zip whose entries extract correctly on Linux

title: Relief-softened terminator
description: Replaces the planet's self-shadow on its terrain and ground clutter with a horizon test that closes over a band set by the body's maximum relief, removing the knife-edge terminator on airless and thin-air bodies

title: Shader file redirect into a patched shadow tree
description: A Harmony prefix on RenderCore.ShaderModuleUtils.FromFile points every Content/Core/Shaders path at a patched full copy of the tree in the mod folder, so stock shaders and their includes compile from the copy

title: Anchor-verified text patching of the shadow tree
description: Every edit to the copied shaders and XML is a stock-text anchor with an exact expected count, applied all-or-nothing per file, skipped if its marker is present, and logged and skipped when a game update moves it

title: Texture and phase asset scripts
description: Python scripts build every shipped asset (cloud masks, flowmaps, cubemaps, modified stock textures and a Mie phase LUT emitted as GLSL) from source maps, game textures and Mie theory

title: Volumetric cloud map flow and faint-cloud lift
description: Two CloudFunctions.glsl patches that keep volumetric clouds consistent with the 2D layer at the handover, by flowing the map lookups along the 2D flowmap and lifting faint map values through inverse tables

title: Real Atmospheres
description: StarMap mod that rebuilds the Sol system's atmospheres, hazes and clouds from measured data by loading patched copies of KSA's shaders and system XML at launch, and swaps in measured flight atmosphere profiles

title: CI build against private game DLLs with GitHub and SpaceDock releases
description: GitHub Actions workflow that pulls the latest StarMap and KittenExtensions DLLs from their releases, clones private KSA DLLs with a GitHub App token, builds Debug for PRs and Release for main, and publishes to GitHub and SpaceDock when VersionPrefix changes

title: Cross-pass image references
description: PostProcessingInputReference and PostProcessingOutputReference child elements bind the input or output image of another pass, picked by RenderPassId and by pre- or post-ImGui stage, as extra sampler2D bindings so a pass can combine images from earlier in the chain

title: Mod-defined uniform buffer bindings
description: Another mod declares a blittable struct as a new XML element; ShaderExtensions allocates a persistently mapped host-coherent uniform buffer for it, binds it to the ShaderEx fragment shader and fills the struct's static lookup delegates so the mod can write the buffer from C# every frame

title: Attribute duck typing as an inter-mod API
description: Consumer mods copy look-alike attribute classes instead of referencing ShaderExtensions; a Program.Main prefix scans every AssemblyLoadContext, matches attributes by full name, closes generic registration methods over the consumer's struct and fills its static delegate fields

title: mod.toml generated by MSBuild with a StarMap dependency
description: An MSBuild targets file copies the build output into Release/<ModName>/ and writes mod.toml from project properties, including a [[StarMap.ModDependencies]] block whose ModId, Optional flag and ImportedAssemblies come from StarMapModDependency items in the csproj

title: Tagging an ImGui window with a draw-list marker callback
description: A no-op ImDrawList callback whose copied user data carries a marker hash and a shader key lets any mod tag the current ImGui window for a custom shader without referencing ShaderExtensions; the renderer later scans each draw list's commands for that marker

title: Per-window ImGui post shader
description: <ImGuiShader> re-renders one tagged ImGui window's draw list offscreen with the backend's own shaders, runs a ShaderEx fragment over its bounding rectangle, and swaps the draw list for a single AddImage of the result before the game's ImGui pass

title: Post-ImGui global post shaders on the swapchain image
description: <GlobalPostShader> passes run after the game's swapchain render pass ends, copying the finished swapchain image (scene plus ImGui) into a tracked render target, running the chain on it and copying the result back into the swapchain image before it is presented

title: RenderPassId-ordered fullscreen pass chain
description: Builds one render target, RenderTechnique pipeline and descriptor set per post-processing shader, ordered by RenderPassId, where each pass samples the previous image through a sampler2D at set 1 binding 0 and draws a four-vertex strip with dynamic rendering

title: Pre-ImGui post-processing on the HDR scene image
description: <PostProcessingShader> passes run on the game's HDR offscreen color image immediately before the swapchain render pass that tonemaps the scene and draws ImGui, then copy their result back into the offscreen image so the game's final composite reads it

title: Mod-defined push constants
description: Another mod declares a small blittable struct as an XML element whose value lives in managed memory, becomes a VkPushConstantRange in the pass pipeline layout and is pushed with vkCmdPushConstants every time the pass is recorded

title: Rebuilding mod GPU resources with the game renderer
description: A Program.RebuildRenderer postfix, a forced renderer rebuild on the first rendered frame and a per-frame extent check keep the post-processing chains, their render targets and the shared time buffer in step with swapchain resizes and graphics-setting changes

title: RenderGame transpiler around the swapchain render pass
description: A Harmony transpiler on Program.RenderGame swaps the swapchain BeginRenderPass call for a static method with the same stack signature that records mod passes first, and inserts a call after the last EndRenderPass, giving the mod two command-recording slots outside any render pass

title: ShaderEx asset with extra descriptor bindings
description: A ShaderReference subclass registered as the <ShaderEx> XML element that gives a fragment shader extra texture and uniform-buffer bindings by building its own descriptor pool, set layout and writes from the element's children

title: Shared shader time uniform buffer
description: One persistently mapped uniform buffer holding frame number, frame delta, real time, simulation time and warp rate, rewritten from a Program.RenderGame prefix every flight frame and bound at binding 1 of every ShaderEx descriptor set

title: Custom XML asset types and injected child elements
description: Registers the four asset types through KittenExtensions attributes and runs its own copy of KittenExtensions' XmlAttributeOverrides injector in a Program.Main prefix to add buffer, push constant and pass-reference child elements before any game XML is parsed

title: ShaderExtensions
description: Shader infrastructure mod adding XML-declared fragment shaders with extra texture, uniform-buffer and push-constant bindings, per-window ImGui shaders, and RenderPassId-ordered post-processing chains before and after the ImGui pass via a Program.RenderGame transpiler

title: Discover lifecycle hooks by attribute type name
description: StarMap finds a mod's [StarMapMod] class and its hook methods by comparing attribute type names rather than Type identity, validates each signature with StarMap's own attribute instance, and invokes hooks by reflection on one shared instance
hooks: reflection StarMapModAttribute / StarMapMethodAttribute subclasses (by type name)

title: Frame lifecycle hooks (BeforeGui, AfterGui, AfterOnFrame)
description: StarMap's per-frame hooks are a prefix on Program.OnDrawUiFrame, a postfix on Program.OnDrawUiViewports and a postfix on Program.OnFrame; this maps each to its position in the KSA frame and the state that is valid there

title: Host KSA in-process from a launcher executable
description: StarMap.exe reads StarMapConfig.json, loads KSA.dll and StarMap.Core into a custom AssemblyLoadContext, fixes the working and base directories, and invokes the game's Main by reflection

title: Redirect the KSA documents folder per instance
description: With -InstancePath on StarMap's command line or the STARMAP_INSTANCE_PATH environment variable, a manual Harmony prefix replaces the KSA.Constants.DocumentsFolderPath getter so settings, saves, logs, the manifest and local mods come from another folder

title: Discover code mods through KSA's mod manifest
description: StarMap reuses KSA's native manifest.toml and mod.toml discovery, reads an optional [StarMap] table from each enabled mod, and loads that mod's entry assembly, so a StarMap mod is a KSA content mod plus a DLL

title: Order mod loading with a ModDependencies graph
description: StarMap parks mods whose [[StarMap.ModDependencies]] are not registered yet, releases them when the dependency loads, and retries the rest at the end, loading mods whose only missing dependencies are Optional

title: Restart when new mods are enabled
description: A Harmony prefix on ModLibrary.PrepareAll detects mods the player just enabled in KSA's MOD FOUND popup, which StarMap skipped at launch, and offers to relaunch StarMap.exe so their code loads

title: Isolate each mod in its own AssemblyLoadContext
description: Every StarMap mod gets a non-collectible ModAssemblyLoadContext that resolves shared assemblies from the loader and the game first, then from declared dependency mods, then from the mod's own deps.json

title: Release packaging, StarMap.API NuGet and Windows installer
description: GitHub Actions publish StarMap as a framework-dependent win-x64 folder zipped without pdb and xml files, push StarMap.API to NuGet, cut release-candidate builds from dev, and build an Inno Setup installer that writes StarMapConfig.json

title: Share contract assemblies between mods with ExportedAssemblies and ImportedAssemblies
description: A dependent mod's load context resolves selected assembly names from its dependency's load context, so both mods see one Assembly, one Type identity and one set of statics for an inter-mod contract

title: Startup lifecycle hooks (BeforeMain, ImmediateLoad, AllModsLoaded)
description: Where StarMapBeforeMain, StarMapImmediateLoad and StarMapAllModsLoaded fire relative to KSA's Program constructor, and exactly which game state exists at each

title: Startup modal popup with a self-pumped frame
description: StarMap shows its restart question during KSA's loading phase by subclassing KSA.Popup and running its own GLFW poll, ImGui frame and Vulkan submit loop, copied from the game's ConfirmMods dialog

title: Unload hook and shutdown order
description: StarMapUnload runs after KSA's Main has returned and Program.Dispose has destroyed the renderer, and after StarMap has removed every Harmony patch in the process; Environment.Exit paths skip it

title: StarMap
description: The community code-mod loader for KSA, which launches the game in its own process, loads each mod's DLL into an isolated AssemblyLoadContext, resolves mod dependencies, and calls mods back at seven lifecycle points through Harmony patches

title: Feed runtime-created engines through their declared feed connectors
description: Blinky connects each pixel engine's RocketCore.FeedConnectors entry to a tank part, aligns its stage, rebuilds the resource managers and reads Combustor.ResourceManager.ConsumptionOrder to prove every engine can reach propellant
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: Create, Repair Feed, Diagnose, Ignite)

title: Build NxM grids of real engine parts on a live vessel at runtime
description: Blinky creates hundreds of engine parts from a PartTemplate, wires them under the vessel root by hand through TreeParent and TreeChildren, and rebuilds the vessel with one PartTree.CreateFromNewPartTree call instead of merging part by part
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: Create button)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: deferred destroy queue)

title: Drive a pixel display by switching engine controllers on and off
description: Blinky lights grid pixels with buffered EngineController.SetIsActive calls, offering pattern presets, a diffing static display and a column-stepped scrolling marquee, while the shared PartRenderFilter hides the tiny engine meshes
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: pattern buttons)
harmony-prefix KSA.PartTreeRenderData.Compose / ComposeDynamic / ComposeGlass (shared PartRenderFilter, owner blinky)
harmony-postfix KSA.PartTreeRenderData.Compose / ComposeDynamic / ComposeGlass (shared PartRenderFilter, owner blinky)

title: Procedural ring band textures uploaded through the game's own TextureReference.Bind
description: Bloomin' Onion rasterizes stripes and ringlet noise into a 2048x1 RGBA8 band plus a control strip, wraps each in a TextureReference subclass whose private TextureAsset is seeded by reflection, and binds it through the game so it gets a bindless handle like any stock texture
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Apply builds the textures, the panel draws a preview strip)

title: Add planetary rings to any celestial at runtime
description: Bloomin' Onion builds a complete PlanetaryRingsReference tree in code, assigns it to a body template and forces the planetary rings renderer to be recreated so the ring appears without touching game data
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Apply / Remove buttons)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; body and asset refresh every 2 s)

title: Play imported sound files in 3D at a vessel through nonblocking FMOD streams on the game's Sfx group
description: BYO Music plays imported OGG, WAV or MP3 files as nonblocking 3D FMOD streams on KSA's own system and Sfx group, positioned at a vessel each frame through SpatialAudio, with loops, real-time gaps and scene saves
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (ByoMusicSubmod.Update ticks every VesselSound; hidden-HUD replay in unscience)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (panel in ISubmod.RenderContent, import browser in RenderFloatingWindows)
unscience save participant byo-music (order 220) via the shared native save hooks

title: Cinematic camera moves by pre-empting the Orbit and Fly controllers
description: A shared Harmony prefix on OrbitController.OnFrame and FlyController.OnFrame hands the controller's live Camera to an animation player while a sequence plays, so ten eased, target-relative moves (zooms, spirals, orbits, loopy orbit, shake, pan, rotate) replace the stock camera math for that frame
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, Play/Pause/Stop buttons)

title: Keyframe camera sequences with parallel groups, return-to-start and saved recipes
description: KeyframeSequencePlayer chains camera animations into a played, paused or stopped sequence, composes simultaneous moves as one keyframe, blends back to the captured start pose, and saves the authored sequence as validated recipe JSON with the scene
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, sequence panel)

title: Camera-origin vessel launcher with target-relative velocity
description: Dent Wizard teleports a chosen vessel, EVA kitten or debris to the camera and fires it at a clicked hull or terrain point by building a new orbit and calling Vehicle.Teleport at the PrepareFrame physics handoff
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows, click capture)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, source validation)

title: Spawn EVA kittens anywhere by replicating EVADoor.CreateKittenEva
description: doh builds KittenEva vessels beside a chosen vehicle by copying the stock EVA door sequence (backpack part with its own tree, eight-argument constructor, CreateFromStateCci orbit, Teleport) after waiting out the vehicle solver
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (Spawn and Despawn buttons in ISubmod.RenderContent)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (ISubmod.Update prunes kittens the game removed)

title: Per-kitten tints by cloning GPU materials inside the fixed 512-slot material pool
description: doh clones each kitten's materials into new GpuMaterialSystem slots with a custom AlbedoColor, swaps MaterialIndices to the clones, and budgets and frees slots in the fixed 512-slot pool
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (spawn, recolour and despawn from DohSubmod.RenderContent)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (DohSubmod.Update prunes kittens and releases stale sets)
unscience save participant doh (order 60) via the shared native save hooks

title: Don't Stifle Me editor free scaling (unclamped, per-axis, unsnapped)
description: Don't Stifle Me widens VehicleEditor.ScaleBoundsFor with a postfix, replaces the uniform UpdateSelectedScale drag with a per-axis one that reuses the game's private QuantizeScale and ForEachPartWithSymmetry through delegates, and can bypass the 0.25 m snapping

title: Parachute diameter unclamp ("jpl said no clamps")
description: Don't Stifle Me widens each parachute's runtime Tuning.MinDiameterM and MaxDiameterM to 2-1000 m from prefixes on VehicleEditor.DrawParachuteSection and Parachute.SetDiameter, tracking every touched instance so disabling or unloading restores the authored bounds

title: Infinite fuel and battery refill before the vehicle solver snapshot
description: Eternal Flame refills tanks with Vehicle.RefillConsumables and batteries with Battery.Refill from a Priority.First prefix on Universe.ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers so the refill lands before the vehicle worker snapshots module state

title: Minimal standalone StarMap mod template with a separate feature library
description: The fixme-mod-name project pair is the repo's scaffold for a new mod, a StarMap entry class with the four lifecycle attributes, a Harmony patcher that always applies the hotkey guard, an F11 ImGui window and a sibling .lib project, copied and renamed by mkmod.ts

title: Swap every parachute canopy's material at draw time
description: A Harmony prefix on ChuteRenderable.Draw reflects the private AnimatedRenderable and overwrites slot 0 of its protected MaterialIndices with one runtime MaterialData (tint, PBR multipliers or uniform PBR, custom albedo), capturing and later restoring each canopy's native material handle
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Apply / Restore Stock)

title: Material-gated full-canopy projection by patching KSA's model shaders in memory
description: Prefixes on Utils.SetShaderFromMod and ShaderModuleUtils.FromFile recompile Model.vert, Model_Skinned.vert and ModelPbr.frag from patched source, adding a bind-pose projection UV that ModelPbr.frag uses for albedo only on materials whose ExtraData carries Free Fallin's marker

title: Runtime canopy textures from PNGs, CPU compositing over a BC7 stock texture, and owned GPU assets
description: Free Fallin builds canopy textures on the CPU (PNG decode, a centred decal over the stock BC7 albedo re-opened from KTX2 with an RGBA32 transcode, a 1x1 PBR map), registers them with GpuTextureSystem.TryAddTexture and releases its own entries through the protected AssetMap

title: Non-cumulative per-axis part scaling with captured baselines
description: Garry's Torch multiplies each full part's captured Part.Scale by independent XYZ factors, lets sub-parts inherit, restores the originals on unweld, extends kitten avatars to XYZ with a Harmony postfix and excludes Godzilla through VehicleScaleOwnership
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, UI scale edits)
harmony-transpiler KSA.Program.PrepareFrame (shared PhysicsFrameHook, animated scale edits)

title: Per-vessel collision suppression by bracketing ConstraintSim passes
description: Garry's Torch removes welded sources from Bepu broad-phase collision for the duration of each ConstraintSim.DetectCollisions and Simulate call with a prefix that calls BodyReference.SetShape(default) and a finalizer that restores the exact shape
hooks: harmony-transpiler KSA.Program.PrepareFrame (shared PhysicsFrameHook, publishes the source set)

title: Part-anchored vehicle welding by per-frame teleport at the physics handoff
description: Garry's Torch holds a source vessel at a fixed offset from a part on a target vessel by teleporting it every frame from a PhysicsFrameHook.BeforePhysics callback stamped with SimStep.PreviousTime
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, weld editing UI)

title: Eased weld animation queues and TOML weld presets
description: Garry's Torch interpolates weld offset, rotation and XYZ scale with eased per-weld animation queues advanced at the physics handoff in player time, and stores reusable weld settings as named presets in a Tomlyn TOML file with legacy-key migration
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, preset UI)

title: Main-camera field-of-view override with lens presets
description: Glass drives the main viewport camera's FOV from a static FovController and keeps it there with two main-camera-only prefixes, one on Camera.ChangeFieldOfView that swallows the stock FOV keys and one on Camera.UpdateProjection that writes the private _fovRadians field before every projection rebuild

title: Collider-only scaling through native owned shapes with nominal bounds preserved
description: Godzilla's collider channel overrides the scale ColliderModule.SetScale receives and the collider centre getter, then rebuilds the collision compound through the private Vehicle.UpdateCollisionGeometry while keeping the nominal physics bounds

title: Whole-vessel scaling with Smart and Basic modes and three independent channels
description: Godzilla resizes a vessel or EVA kitten from a captured snapshot in Smart (uniform, spaced about the centre of mass) or Basic (raw XYZ) mode, with native module and collider refresh at the physics handoff and independent render, physics and collider channels
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, requests only)

title: Render-only vessel scaling with draw-matrix and cull-radius patches
description: Godzilla's visual channel scales a vessel's drawn parts around its live centre of mass and enlarges only its render cull radius, using part-tree draw-matrix patches, a GetWorldMatrix postfix and two guarded call-site transpilers

title: PNG decals as mod-owned slots in KSA's bindless texture table
description: Graffiti decodes library PNGs with the game's TextureLoader, uploads them as mip-mapped SimpleVkTextures, claims slots in Program.BindlessTextures so the shader needs only a uint index, hot-swaps changed files on Rescan and destroys freed images after every frame in flight has retired
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; retire-queue tick)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent / RenderFloatingWindows; upload on place or Rescan)

title: Per-frame decal anchoring to parts, canopy cloth and terrain
description: Decals store part-local, cloth-barycentric or geodetic anchors, re-resolve them by stable ids every frame and recompose a double-precision decal-to-ego box, so they follow staging, inflation, planet rotation and floating-origin shifts and go dormant instead of being deleted when the anchor despawns
hooks: harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: One-shot click placement with mesh, cloth, kitten and terrain picking
description: An armed ImGui placement mode turns the next world click into a decal anchor by casting Cursor.GetEgoRay against live parachute cloth triangles, Part.RayCastEgo view meshes, a KittenEva bounding sphere and finally a CPU march over the accurate terrain height field

title: Projected PNG decal pass recorded after the main-view resolve
description: A Harmony postfix on RenderTarget.ResolveAttachments records a custom Vulkan pass in the post-resolve window KSA's GridPass uses, drawing one unit cube per decal whose fragment shader rebuilds the scene position from reverse-Z depth and projects a PNG onto it
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; matrices and GPU bring-up)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: Click-to-mount picking on vessel meshes with stable part anchoring
description: A one-shot click casts Cursor.GetEgoRay against every vessel with Part.RayCastEgo, stores the hit in the hit sub-part's local frame and re-resolves the anchor each frame by vehicle id and Part.InstanceId, going dormant when the target is gone
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows, armed click)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, target re-resolution)
harmony-prefix KSA.FixedController.OnFrame(IViewport, double) (re-resolution before the pose)

title: Live part-mounted cameras in leased stock secondary viewports
description: Hot Pursuit claims stock secondary viewports through ViewportRegistry and replaces FixedController.OnFrame only for its own viewports with a part-relative pose and nearby-celestial sync, so the stock renderer draws a camera riding a sub-part
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, lease sync and follow)

title: Engine glow override through the dynamic part instance submission
description: A Harmony prefix on PartModelDynamic's private AddInstance rewrites each instance's Temperature and TfiThickness just before it is appended to the frame's instance list, so the game's own ENABLE_TEMPERATURE heat lookup and thin-film shading make chosen engine models glow without any shader change

title: Kitten tinting by staged writes into the GPU material buffer

hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Initialize, Apply, Reset)

title: Hide kitten helmet visors with a draw-call transpiler
description: A Harmony transpiler on KittenRenderable.UpdateRenderData replaces exactly one VisorMesh.Draw(ViewHandle) call with a static helper that skips the draw while a session flag is set, hiding visor glass on every kitten in every pass and view without touching materials or meshes
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Hide/Show button)

title: Per-part vehicle paint through free state-flag bits and an in-memory part shader patch

hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Enable, blend mode, colour edits)

title: Bypass the one-pixel render cull for chosen vessels

description: Kitchen Sink swaps the main viewport's IVAController for a subclass that delegates movement to a private FlyController in the vessel body frame, keeping IVA mode, audio, ray tracing and interiors while the camera leaves the seat

subclass-override KSA.IVAController.OnFrame, OnKey, OnMouseButton, OnCursorPos, OnScroll, GetCursorMode, OnSwitchOff
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, validity check)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, Unlock and Return to Seat)

title: Catalog every animation clip, blend sampler and anim processor a live kitten has loaded
description: Kitten Animations catalogs every playable clip of a live kitten: ground clips and blend samplers from private KittenRenderable fields, MMU and overlay clips from CharacterAvatar, and the four anim processors by name
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (catalog and processors rebuilt on bind in KittenAnimationsSubmod.Update)
reflection KSA.KittenRenderable._groundIdleAnim ... _seatedIdleActionAnims (13 private clip fields, cached FieldInfo)

title: Facial expressions through a mod-owned CatExpressionAnim, plus anim-processor strength overrides
description: Kitten Animations plays facial expressions through its own CatExpressionAnim appended to AnimProcessors with an eased or latched envelope, and re-applies ear, eye and mood-face knobs from the pose prefix
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (Expressions and Animation Strength sections)

title: Force any animation clip on an EVA kitten from a prefix on AnimatedRenderable.UpdateAnimation
description: Kitten Animations holds a chosen clip on an EVA kitten against the game's per-frame clip choice from a Harmony prefix on AnimatedRenderable.UpdateAnimation, with blend, rate, freeze, restart and saved phase
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (KittenAnimationsSubmod.Update resolves and binds the target)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (Target and Playback sections in ISubmod.RenderContent)
reflection KSA.AnimatedRenderable.RuntimeAnim, KSA.BoneAnimRuntime.TimeSinceTransition and CurrentAnimation (protected; saved phase only)

title: Live animation tuning on KittenLocomotionTuning.Current with a scoped reset and a scene-save record
description: Kitten Animations edits the 20 animation-facing fields of the global KittenLocomotionTuning.Current in place, resets only those, shows live blend weights, and saves them with clip and expression state
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (TuningSection writes ref KittenLocomotionTuning.Current fields)
unscience save participant kitten-animations (default order 100) via the shared native save hooks

title: Celestial welding by rewriting a body's orbit before every sim step
description: Kiwi's Marbles pins a planet or moon at a CCI-frame offset from another celestial or a vessel by building a fresh orbit from the target's state vectors in a Priority.First prefix on Universe.ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers, before the orbit workers snapshot it
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: create, edit, unweld)
harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.DeserializeSave (shared NativeSaveHooks: restore original orbits)

title: Cross-parent celestial welds with explicit IParentBody.Children re-parenting
description: When a weld moves a body under a different parent, Kiwi's Marbles calls Celestial.SetOrbit, then moves the body between the old and new parents' Children lists itself and refreshes the moved subtree, because KSA re-parents only vessels automatically
hooks: harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.ExecuteNextVehicleSolvers (priority First, shared with the weld update)
harmony-postfix KSA.Universe.DeserializeSave (shared NativeSaveHooks: replay with parent-graph checks)

title: Thin static providers that funnel game-state access through one library
description: Static wrappers for vessels, celestials, sim time, part trees and user-data paths, plus reflection and easing helpers, so game-state access goes through one library and a game update breaks one place instead of thirty features

title: Keep per-frame mod work running while the HUD is hidden
description: A Harmony prefix on Program.OnDrawUiConsole replays a host's StarMap BeforeGui and AfterGui work in frames where F2 or a screenshot capture has hidden the HUD and StarMap's GUI hooks are skipped

title: Block game hotkeys while an ImGui text field has focus
description: A Harmony prefix on GameSettings.OnKeyAll reports the key event as handled whenever ImGui wants text input, so typing into any mod text box never triggers game key bindings

title: ISubmod contract for features that run standalone or inside a supermod
description: A five-method ImGui panel interface plus static Apply and Remove Harmony patch classes lets each feature library be hosted either by its own StarMap mod or by one aggregating supermod without code changes
hooks: starmap StarMapAllModsLoaded (host calls Initialize and the patch class Apply)
starmap StarMapUnload (host calls Dispose and Remove)

title: Force IVA interior models to render outside IVA
description: Flips the shared PartModelModule.Template.Internal flag on loaded and newly constructed part models, with an owner-counted requirement API and a Compose prefix and finalizer that reveal interiors in the vehicle editor for one call at a time

title: Native save and load hooks that bracket every KSA save transaction
description: Harmony patches on GameSave.Populate, UncompressedSave.Write and Load, and Universe.DeserializeSave and LoadSystem publish capture, write, reset and restore callbacks and defer every world replacement to the PrepareFrame handoff

title: Hide individual part meshes by compacting the per-frame instance lists
description: Shared prefix and postfix pairs on PartTreeRenderData.Compose, ComposeDynamic and ComposeGlass record where each model's instances start and remove hidden parts from the appended range before the lists are uploaded, so parts stay in the vessel but are not drawn
hooks: reflection KSA.PartTreeRenderData.Batch.Model / Parts / Count (and DynamicBatch, GlassBatch)

title: Physics-safe vessel mutation at the PrepareFrame solver handoff
description: A transpiler on Program.PrepareFrame swaps the Universe.GetJobSimStep call for a dispatcher that runs queued vessel edits after solver results are applied and before the next physics step is snapshotted
hooks: reflection KSA.Program.PrepareFrame (private, looked up by name)

title: Stable vehicle and part identity across save and reload
description: SavedPartReference addresses a part by vehicle id, tree and sub-part index paths, template id and a SHA-256 topology signature of the whole vehicle, and resolves to null rather than substituting another vehicle or part

title: Scene save coordinator with ordered reset, deferred replay and retained records
description: A game-independent coordinator captures versioned JSON records from feature participants, validates incoming records before the world is touched, resets old ownership in reverse order and replays restores in order after KSA rebuilds the world

title: Shared copied-import media catalogs with an ImGui file browser
description: SharedFileLibrary keeps flat, non-overwriting catalogs of user files under .unscience (pngs, glbs, sounds) that several features share, and LibraryFileBrowser is a reusable ImGui filesystem picker that always copies the chosen file into the catalog before handing back its catalog name
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (browser windows drawn from ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows)

title: Enumerate the game's 954 named XKCD colors by reflection
description: XkcdColorHelper reflects over the static Color.Preset properties of KSA.KSAColor.Xkcd once, caches name and float4 pairs sorted by name, and serves them to filterable color pickers

title: Validate Part asset bundles with fifteen rules before anything is written or registered
description: Parts Now deserializes submitted XML with KSA's own AssetBundle serializer but never calls OnDataLoad, then runs rules V1-V15 as isolated pure functions over the set, blocking the load on any error, including the PbrMaterial channel crash guard and the V8 registry rule
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (loader Validate state via ISubmod.Update)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (paste panel Validate button via ISubmod.RenderContent)
reflection KSA.ModLibrary registries and KSA.VehicleEditor._editorTagLookup (read-only, through GameRegistry)

title: Reserve headroom in KSA's shared interleaved mesh buffer before it is allocated
description: Parts Now inflates DeviceMeshInterleaved.Shared size counters from StarMapAllModsLoaded, before ModLibrary.Bind sizes the one shared vertex and index buffer, then rewinds the bump cursor on the first frame so runtime meshes get valid offsets
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, first frame only, MeshBudget.OnFirstFrame)

title: Turn pasted Part XML into a real, enabled KSA mod folder from inside the game
description: Parts Now validates a mod id, writes mod.toml plus up to three XML bundles atomically (UTF-8 without BOM, LF) under the game's own mods folder, adds an enabled manifest entry, and classifies existing mod folders for loading
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent, paste form, Validate and Install buttons)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, WriteModFolder state and manifest stamp)

title: One reflection layer with a startup self-test that disables loading instead of crashing
description: Parts Now resolves every KSA internal it needs (six ModLibrary registries, SerializedCollection._collection, VehicleEditor._editorTagLookup) once in a non-throwing static constructor, sorts failures into fatal and degraded, and gates loading on the result
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (StatusPanel recomputes LoadingEnabled every UI frame)
reflection KSA.ModLibrary.AllParts, AllMeshes, AllFiles, AllMaterials, AllPartGameDataReferences, AllEditorTagDefinitions

title: Load, reload and roll back Part mods at runtime with a one-state-per-frame loader
description: Parts Now replays KSA's boot asset pipeline for one mod folder after startup, from parse and register through background file loading, GPU binding, incremental game-data attach and thumbnails, one state per frame from the pre-GUI hook
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, one loader state per frame)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (unscience HiddenUiFrameHook replays Update while the HUD is hidden)
reflection KSA.ModLibrary.AllParts, AllPartGameDataReferences, AllMaterials, AllFiles, AllMeshes (through GameRegistry)

title: Unload runtime-registered parts behind a fail-closed safety gate
description: Parts Now refuses to unload while anything live could reference a mod's parts, then purges in a fixed order (device idle, templates, caches, textures, meshes, registries) and defers the purge to the pre-GUI hook so freed ImGui textures are never drawn
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, deferred unload and reload purge)
reflection KSA.SerializedCollection._collection (private hash dictionary behind Find)
reflection KSA.ModLibrary.AllParts, AllPartGameDataReferences, AllMaterials, AllFiles, AllMeshes

title: Render part-browser thumbnails at runtime on KSA's offscreen thumbnail viewport
description: Parts Now gives runtime-loaded parts real editor thumbnails by combining ThumbnailCreator's boot framing with ThumbnailDynamic's per-frame submit, rendering two parts per frame on Program.ThumbnailViewport with a private command pool and one fence wait per part
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (ISubmod.Update -> RuntimeModLoader Thumbnails state, 2 parts per frame)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (unscience HiddenUiFrameHook replays Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: Cancellable one-shot GPU upload submission with publish-after-fence and retire-after-idle
description: Pebbles uploads CPU-built buffers and textures through a private one-shot command buffer and fence, using a StagingPool only for memory so failed recordings are never auto-submitted, publishing after the fence and freeing after Device.WaitIdle
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; Workshop preview uploads and draws, Sphinx placements and texture edits)
harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.ExecuteNextClothSolvers (GLB texture uploads while a clutter Apply builds its private graph)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: Authored clutter colliders mapped onto native collider templates with a private convex-hull subclass
description: Pebbles maps box, sphere, capsule, cylinder and hull collider recipes onto KSA ColliderTemplate types, including a private OwnedHull with stock-matching centroid and volume, so native clutter physics builds, scales and frees the Bepu shapes
hooks: harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.ExecuteNextClothSolvers (colliders are built inside the Pebbles clutter commit)
subclass KSA.ColliderTemplate (private OwnedHull overrides CreateShapeInto, ShapeOffsetCollider and VolumeCubicMetres)
reflection KSA.ClutterEcotypePhysicalData._primitiveShapes and _compoundShapes (shape cleanup after a failed build)

title: Removed and displaced clutter carried per grid spacing across swaps and saves
description: Pebbles remembers knocked-over and removed clutter per ecotype and exact spacing, replays it into each new placement, rewrites native clutter save entries in a SerializeSave postfix and keeps override grids in a pebbles.clutter-state sidecar record
hooks: harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.ExecuteNextClothSolvers (drain, remember and replay during apply and restore)
unscience save participants pebbles (order 60) and pebbles.clutter-state (order 61) via the shared native save hooks

title: Bounded GLB 2.0 import into unregistered CPU-only meshes with frozen path and hash ids
description: Pebbles reads self-contained GLB files with its own bounded parser, bakes scene node and UV transforms, wraps the result in CPU-only MeshReference objects never added to ModLibrary, and freezes every library choice to an absolute-path plus SHA-256 mesh id
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows and RenderContent; import and mesh selection)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; registry discovery and shared-library rescans)
reflection KSA.ModLibrary.AllMeshes, AllFiles and AllGltfs (internal static collections)

title: GLB PBR materials converted to native clutter maps with private bindless textures
description: Pebbles bakes glTF metallic-roughness materials and common Blender extensions into native diffuse, packed AO-roughness-metal, normal and cutout maps on the CPU, then uploads each as a private SimpleVkTexture with its own bindless slot set by reflection
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent and RenderFloatingWindows; CPU conversion when a mesh is selected)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; GPU upload on Workshop preview refresh and Sphinx placement)
harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.ExecuteNextClothSolvers (GPU upload during a clutter Apply)

title: Per-celestial ground clutter replacement with transactional apply and restore
description: Pebbles swaps the meshes, materials, scale and colliders of chosen clutter types on one celestial by building private native clutter bundles in a Universe.ExecuteNextClothSolvers prefix, keeping the originals for exact restore
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; scene changes, requeue, discovery)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: Private clutter material buffer and source-color shader variant scoped to owned construction
description: Pebbles redirects the game's ground clutter material buffer lookups to a private per-body buffer and swaps in a source-color ClutterSolidFrag variant, only while a thread-static owned-construction context is active
hooks: harmony-prefix constructors of KSA.GroundClutterPlacementData, KSA.ClutterEcotypeRenderData, KSA.ClutterEcotypePhysicalData, KSA.ClutterCubeCellGrid, KSA.ClutterViewResources, RenderCore.Mesh.SimpleVkMeshAtlas

title: Floating collider workshop with a textured preview, CPU-projected gizmos and detached undo history

hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows; window, canvas, gizmos, inspector, input)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; preview refresh and offscreen render)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)

title: Independent offscreen Vulkan preview rendered before the GUI and shown as an ImGui image
description: Pebbles renders the Workshop mesh into private color and depth images with a dynamic-rendering pipeline and runtime-compiled GLSL, submits it with a fence in StarMapBeforeGui, and shows the result through the ImGui Vulkan backend
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update -> WorkshopEditor.Update; scene build, offscreen render, private queue submission)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (HiddenUiFrameHook replays ISubmod.Update while the HUD is hidden)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderFloatingWindows; AddImage of the finished target)

title: Synthesize plume physics from nozzle parameters with an isentropic model

starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: create, tune, presets)

hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; refresh every 2 s until populated)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Rescan Assets button and combos)

description: Rocky McRock Face clones interleaved part and subpart meshes into private Simple MeshReferences that share the retained CPU HostPrimitives and uploads them as SimpleVkMesh for the ring pipeline, and imports glTF-file meshes the same way
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; conversion happens on Apply)

title: Swap the meshes and textures of existing planetary rings at runtime
description: Rocky McRock Face mutates the public XML-backed ring reference tree of a ringed body (LOD meshes, rock material, band texture, field settings), snapshots the originals, and recreates the rings renderer so the constructor-baked ring data is rebuilt from the edit
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent; Apply / Restore Defaults buttons)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update; ringed-body rescan every 2 s)

starmap StarMapAfterGui (panel and Save Now button)

title: Global ImGui themes by rewriting ImGui.GetStyle(), with TOML theme files and scene-saved styles

starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent and RenderFloatingWindows: panel, armed terrain click)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (shared HiddenUiFrameHook replays Update while the HUD is hidden)
harmony-postfix KSA.StaticObjectRenderer.UpdateRenderData (per-viewport placement matrix, see render hooks)

title: Automatic box or mesh colliders for imported statics with scoped Bepu hooks
description: Sphinx gives each placed GLB a global Bepu Box or two-sided Mesh chosen by conservative closed-box detection, adds per-bubble static handles from a ConstraintSim.BeginStaticObjectPass postfix, and admits them to contact generation and ground-contact logic only for its own handles
hooks: harmony-transpiler KSA.NarrowPhaseCallbacks.AllowContactGeneration (internal type looked up by name)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: collider build and retirement after solver waits)

title: Drawing private meshes through the native static-object pipelines with three postfixes
description: Sphinx postfixes StaticObjectRenderer.UpdateRenderData, the private WriteCommandsColor and WriteCommandsPrePass so its own vertex, index, material and matrix buffers are drawn while the game's static-object pipeline, lighting and shadow descriptor sets are still bound
hooks: harmony-postfix KSA.StaticObjectRenderer.WriteCommandsColor (private, looked up by name and parameter types)

title: Live per-static UV scale and offset with shared-PNG texture overrides
description: Sphinx keeps each static's imported vertices in managed memory and re-uploads only private vertex buffers with UV times scale plus offset for repeatable edits, while a PNG override rebuilds the whole private resource first so a failed texture never replaces the working one
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: texture combo and UV widgets)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: queued texture edits)
harmony-postfix KSA.StaticObjectRenderer.WriteCommandsColor (draws the remapped buffers, see render hooks)

title: Per-vessel indestructibility without touching shared part templates
description: The Tick makes registered vessels immune to force-based destruction with a prefix on the Part.CrashTolerancePascals getter and a prefix and postfix pair on PhysicsBubble.DetectStructuralFailure that discards only the event the detector just created
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update, registry pruning)

description: Thug Life builds its sunglasses image from an ASCII grid into an R8G8B8A8 SimpleVkTexture with a staging upload and a nearest-neighbour sampler, and emits one small quad per opaque texel because the stock unlit shader always writes alpha 1
hooks: starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: first Add Sunglasses builds the texture)

title: Draw a part-anchored textured quad inside the scene's opaque pass
description: Thug Life postfixes SuperMeshRenderSystem.RenderMainPass to record its own Vulkan draws with the stock UnlitMesh shaders into the offscreen MSAA pass, builds its pipeline lazily against Program.OffscreenTarget, and computes an ego-space MVP per entry from the camera of the viewport being rendered
hooks: starmap StarMapAllModsLoaded (via unscience ISubmod.Initialize: manager created, no GPU work)
starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: slide animation)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: add, tune, remove entries)

title: One shipped mod folder from thirty-plus projects, with dist validation and rolling GitHub releases
description: MSBuild resolves the game DLLs once for every project, only the unscience project deploys, copying exactly the MeowSci assemblies of its reference closure plus Tomlyn, and CI stamps the version, validates the folder and publishes rolling releases

title: One Harmony instance applying 30-plus feature patch classes in isolation
description: The supermod's Patcher creates a single Harmony instance and applies every feature library's static patch class through a TryApply wrapper, so one stale game target disables only its own feature, then removes them all on unload

title: Native-free managed test executables that run production patches against stand-in KSA types
description: Eighteen console projects compile production sub-mod files by link, declare small namespace-KSA stand-ins with the game's member names and apply the real Harmony patches to them, so timing, save and patch logic is checked without starting the game

harmony-prefix KSA.Part.CrashTolerancePascals (applied to a fixture copy)

title: Add an entry to the game's main menu bar through DrawProgramMenusHook

title: Per-save scene sidecar wiring and the participant inventory

title: Supermod host that aggregates 31 feature panels into one window
description: The unscience StarMap entry class builds every ISubmod at StarMapAllModsLoaded, ticks them all each frame, renders them as collapsible sections of one ImGui window and persists only its own window layout and header state

title: Disco party lights with per-instance light templates and owned actuators
description: Zippo's Disco runs repeating color, assembly-actuation and spotlight-spread channels on one light or a whole vessel by swapping each LightModule's Template for a private copy, claiming each keyframe actuator for one owner, and restoring only the values it still owns
hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: Disco tick)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (shared HiddenUiFrameHook replays Update while the HUD is hidden)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: recipe editor, start, inspectors)
harmony-prefix KSA.Universe.DeserializeSave (shared NativeSaveHooks: stop and restore)

hooks: starmap StarMapBeforeGui (via unscience ISubmod.Update: animation tick)
harmony-prefix KSA.Program.OnDrawUiConsole (shared HiddenUiFrameHook replays Update while the HUD is hidden)
starmap StarMapAfterGui (via unscience ISubmod.RenderContent: queue builder and progress)

title: Light part selection and template-level color and intensity writes with a public API
description: Zippo finds light parts by walking a vessel's part tree for LightModule template data, writes intensity and RGB color into the shared PartTemplate light components by reflection, toggles PowerConsumer.LightIsActive, ledgers originals for save and reset, and exposes the same operations to other mods

title: unscience

description: Builds NxM grids of real engine parts on a live vessel at runtime and lights them as an LCD display by switching engine controllers, with feed wiring, patterns and scrolling text

title: Bloomin' Onion

description: Attaches imported OGG, WAV or MP3 files to vessels as 3D sounds on KSA's own FMOD system, with seamless loops, real-time gaps between plays, live edits and scene saves

title: Camera Controller Override

title: Dent Wizard

title: Don't Stifle Me
description: Vehicle-editor un-limiter: lifts the 0.5x-2x part scale clamp, restores per-axis gizmo scaling with optional unsnapped values, and can widen parachute diameter to 2-1000 m with exact restore of authored bounds

title: Eternal Flame
description: Keeps monitored vessels topped up with fuel and battery charge from a solver-dispatch prefix that runs before the vehicle worker snapshots module state

title: fixme-mod-name (template)
description: The repository's template mod pair, copied and renamed by mkmod.ts to start a new feature, showing the minimal StarMap host, Harmony patcher with hotkey guard and sibling library project

title: Free Fallin
description: Applies one global look to every parachute canopy by swapping a runtime material into each canopy renderable as it draws, with tints, PBR controls, composited or projected PNG images and exact stock restore

title: Garry's Torch
description: Welds one vessel to a part of another by re-teleporting it every physics handoff, with per-axis part scaling, scoped collision suppression, eased animations, presets and a public API

title: Glass
description: Overrides the main camera field of view with lens presets from 15 degree telephoto to 120 degree fisheye, kept in place by two main-camera-only Harmony prefixes

title: Godzilla
description: Resizes vessels and EVA kittens at runtime with Smart or Basic scaling and independent visual, collider and physics channels, all applied at the physics handoff and exactly restorable

title: Graffiti
description: Click-to-place projected PNG decals on vehicle hulls, deployed parachute canopies, EVA kittens and terrain, rendered in a custom Vulkan pass after the main view's final resolve

title: Hot Pursuit
description: Mounts live cameras on clicked vessel parts by leasing the stock secondary viewports and replacing the fixed camera controller only for those viewports, with mesh-precise placement and stable part anchoring

title: Humble Arteest
description: Three recoloring tools on three render paths, per-part vehicle paint in free state-flag bits with an in-memory shader patch, kitten material tints and visor toggle, and engine heat-glow overrides

title: I Feel Seen
description: Keeps selected vessels and EVA kittens rendered at any distance by bypassing the game's one-pixel cull with skip-original prefixes on two Vehicle render methods

title: Iron Man
description: Lets one live EVA kitten be edited in the stock vehicle editor with private attachment nodes, then flown as an ordinary rocket vessel with headward controls, native flight-computer gauges, early equipment rendering and upright surface teleports

title: It's So Shiny
description: Builds Blinky-style pixel grids from stock light parts instead of engines, powered through battery connections and switched with the stock light switch, with pattern, static and scroll controls

title: jplrepo
description: A tiny development tribute mod that animates cheer phrases on KSA's top menu bar using a call-site transpiler on Program.DrawMenuBar and a prefix on DrawProgramMenusHook

title: Kitchen Sink
description: A grab bag of small KSA fixes: per-vessel G-load invincibility, a free-flying IVA camera, a see-into-the-capsule rendering experiment, forced IVA interior rendering and an editor refresh for invisible sub-parts

title: Kitten Animations
description: Plays any loaded animation clip on a selected EVA kitten against the game's per-frame clip choice, triggers facial expressions through a mod-owned processor, and tunes animation strength and locomotion animation settings

title: Kiwi's Marbles
description: Welds planets and moons to other celestials or vessels at a CCI-frame offset by rewriting their orbits in a solver-dispatch prefix, with explicit parent-tree fix-ups, weld chains and scene-save restore

title: Parts Now
description: Loads, reloads and unloads Part and SubPart mods in a running game, from pasted XML or an existing mod folder, by replaying KSA's boot asset pipeline one state per frame behind validation, a reflection self-test and a fail-closed purge

title: Pebbles
description: Replaces the meshes, materials, scale and colliders of chosen ground clutter types on one celestial with stock or imported GLB models, authored in a floating collider workshop and committed at the solver handoff with exact restore

title: Pyro
description: Places engine-free volumetric exhaust plumes on any vessel part by submitting mod-owned exhaust instances into the game's own plume batch, with nozzle physics, per-plume look overrides, a template editor, presets and on/off cycles

title: Rocky McRock Face
description: Swaps the meshes, textures and rock-field settings of existing planetary rings at runtime by mutating the ring reference tree and rebuilding the ring renderer, with a catalog of every loaded mesh and texture

title: Save Yourself
description: Opt-in timed auto saves that write ordinary native KSA saves through the game's own save path every N wall-clock seconds, with a sanitised name prefix and a global TOML preference file

title: Skittles
description: Global ImGui theme manager that re-themes every game and mod window through ImGui.GetStyle(), with built-in schemes, a live style editor, TOML theme files and scene-saved styles

title: Sphinx
description: Places imported textured GLBs as body-fixed statics with automatic box or mesh colliders, live transforms and UV mapping, drawn through the game's static-object pipelines from three render postfixes and restored by scene saves

title: The Tick
description: Makes chosen vessels indestructible by forces with a crash-tolerance getter prefix and a worker-thread discard of structural destruction events, leaving shared part templates untouched

title: Thug Life
description: Draws the pixel-art sunglasses meme as a textured quad anchored to any vessel part or kitten face, recorded with stock unlit shaders inside the scene's opaque pass from a postfix on SuperMeshRenderSystem.RenderMainPass

title: unscience (supermod host)
description: The only shipped mod: one StarMap entry class that constructs all 31 bundled feature sub-mods, applies their patches through one Harmony instance, renders them in one toolbox window and adds a per-save scene sidecar

title: Zippo
description: Selects vessels and light parts, writes light intensity, color and switch state, queues eased transitions and runs Disco party-light recipes on private per-instance light templates, with a public API and scene-save restore
